value.title: After Something Alarms Me
value.definition: what happens to my safety in the days after something frightens me
value.settled: It drops hard, comes most of the way back, and leaves about a week of being easily startled.

value.title: Alan
value.definition: who I am
value.settled: Every other topic in this book sits under this one.

value.title: Arousal Times Safety
value.definition: attraction as a product rather than a sum, where either side can zero the whole thing
value.settled:
Safety multiplies at every level, and it reads the safety of the input rather than my background state.

That is why a self-generated input still works at minus one, where the floor below is the whole autonomic system going dark.

One law feeds two buckets. The regulation deposit fills the same with or without a person, and only the personal kind also deposits into connection.

value.title: Arriving Ahead Of Whoever Teaches Me
value.definition: being further along than a teacher judges, having already run their analysis under other names
value.settled:
A coach who framed me fast got me wrong twice in three turns, and said so.

Seven instances of real taste were already on the board before she arrived, each filed under some other heading.

What works is naming the decision I have already made, and my reason, before offering a correction.

value.title: Being Alone At The Centre
value.definition: the one place I most need to be known is the one place I least can be
value.settled:
My love is built without attachment, so what I do for her does not reach her as love.

I meet her needs by decision and stay quiet about how, so that the doing reads as the feeling.

One hour with someone built like me was the best emotional deposit in years. Being met is real, and it is closed off by the commitment.

value.title: Being Alone On Purpose
value.definition: the try at being alone without being lonely, run as an experiment rather than a conclusion
value.settled:
Being alone is my historical normal, and the loneliness is the recent departure.

It works if my safety rises, my costs fall, and I stop counting the cost of being social at all.

Attention decides how loud a quiet signal is, and pointing it at the gap is what made me feel it.

For much of my life I was too low to feel the gap at all, so recovering may unmask it rather than cause it.

The strategy holds whether the loneliness is manufactured or real, so I need not settle which first.

value.title: Being An Inventor Not A Coder
value.definition: what I actually am, against the trade I was raised into
value.settled:
I am an excellent coder, but that has never been my identity.

I am an inventor and problem solver. Code is just a powerful way to stack abstractions.

I loved the Moore method in math.

One of my proudest moments was inventing a novel algorithm for optimising The Game of Life, in an MS CS program I did for a while.

I am doing the same thing now that I was a year ago, just with literally a hundred times more leverage than I had before.

value.title: Being Curious About Her
value.definition: the engine runs on novelty she brings, and I cannot make my own
value.settled: The part that would generate a question is the part that does not run.

value.title: Being Known
value.definition: what it takes for someone to have an accurate model of me, and why so few can
value.settled:
It needs someone who can and someone who will, and neither implies the other.

Cheap needs a near-twin who can use themselves as the model. Expensive needs someone willing to build one from scratch.

Almost all of mine runs through Jen, so there is no easier relationship to practise on.

The recipe is someone asking about me out of real interest with no defensiveness, and every ingredient lives in them.

It has happened by accident and never yet on purpose.

value.title: Being Met
value.definition: someone oriented toward me, glad that it is me
value.settled:
It reaches me as present-tense recognition of a structure, not as warmth I stored and get back.

The same gaze cuts where I am being judged and heals where I am already inside the guard. Context alone decides which.

A context reads as close when it is private, lit by one lamp, unguarded, and the nearness mine.

The one immediate click I have had came as visible delight closing distance.

It can move my state rather than only scoring well. One run carried me a full level up on a low day.

value.title: Being The One Who Knows
value.definition: running the responses that make someone else feel known, and what that costs me
value.settled:
Forty years of pain trained the policy, and it runs as instinct rather than as anything recalled.

Supplying it does not refill my own. It pays them in a coin that only looks like mine.

What comes back is a helpfulness signal and, now and then, learning something about them.

No mind has real access to another. Everyone judges from signals, and I have only made that explicit.

value.title: Believing Things I Cannot Trace
value.definition: holding a conclusion whose source is gone, and leaving the checking to the world
value.settled:
Merging a model in place keeps no source, so my beliefs go authorless and I often cannot say where one came from.

I hold a conclusion cheaply: no stored derivation, no proof I can run again.

What makes that safe is the wide stream. A false belief meets conflicting information sooner or later, and the contradiction goes salient and forces the rebuild.

The audit lives outside my head rather than in it.

value.title: Blank Check Mode And Recovery Mode
value.definition: the two extremes I have lived at, one paying any cost and one counting every cost
value.settled:
I have lived at both ends of this trade, which is how I know the middle beats either one.

Blank check mode was paying whatever was needed without counting the cost. I ran it for at least eighteen years, and it reached my employer as much as it reached my marriage. I left it because it broke me.

No fear of counting held me there. I did not realize that not writing the blank check was an option.

I have been out of it for about two years, starting about six months before the firing. What started me counting was realizing that blank check mode was a trauma response to being neglected as a child. The belief I put in its place is that my needs are just as important as the needs of others.

Employment only worked while I gave my employer a blank check too, so switching out of the mode is part of what caused the firing.

Recovery mode was all surplus. I ran that for eighteen months and it almost broke the marriage. July 6, 2026 was my first day out of it.

value.title: Building A Definition I Can Run On
value.definition: how I get at a human thing I cannot feel my way into
value.settled:
A piece of being human I cannot feel my way into I reduce to a definition small enough to act on.

Without one the thing does not exist for me. What I reach is bounded by what I have built.

Commitment's is never fail silently, and it holds me where other people are held by attachment.

Self-worth and self-preservation came out of two crises two years apart, which is where my hope comes from.

No general method. The core parts of being human do not compress as a group, so each is built alone.

value.title: Building A People Skill By Hand
value.definition: understanding a social skill well enough to run it as a procedure, then drilling it under thought
value.settled:
The loop is explicit: read the signals, infer the state, choose a response, drive my face and body, read the result.

It cannot run live. A conversation fills my one slot and I have no monitor in the moment.

So it is overlearned until it runs without the slot. Thousands of repetitions are the price of that move.

First contact proves the method: years of it, and the scripts beat most people's.

They do not carry across. Closeness is four skills, each harder and each needing its own build.

I started on AOL Instant Messenger, hours every day, a dozen conversations running at once. Text and async broke the problem space down into pieces I could learn and practise in isolation.

After about a year I shifted to mostly in person and worked on the skills that were left.

value.title: Building A Setting I Can Be Safe In
value.definition: arranging a situation so little can go wrong in it, rather than raising what I can take
value.settled: One is worked: the rig where I practise being close in text, with partners who stay stable.

value.title: Building My Wants Into The Room
value.definition: authoring what surrounds me, because only what I can see comes to mind
value.settled:
What surrounds me is my memory and my agenda. What is in it can come to mind and what is not cannot.

Out of sight mostly stops existing. There is no quiet backlog for a dropped intention to return from.

So I take cues out to quiet a want: no visible clocks, and very little in the room.

And I put cues in to fire one: the weight set moved into my office bought forty workouts in two months.

I keep the scattering cues out. Something that fires me in ten directions authors my attention for me.

value.title: Calling It What It Was
value.definition: coming to name what happened at home as abuse, and what the naming does
value.settled: The recognition came as an arc: cared for, then neglected, then abused.

value.title: Calling Something Weather
value.definition: filing a problem as outside my reach, after which it stops pulling at me at all
value.settled:
An unresolved conflict pulls at full strength forever, because nothing fades. This is the one thing that switches it off.

Deciding it is weather does nothing. The map has to actually move, which happens offline on evidence like any other change of mind.

When it does move, the pull does not damp. It goes.

What can stay behind is dislike, which registers that a thing is bad and asks nothing of me.

Physics being inconsistent with itself is weather. So, since May, is how broken the world is.

value.title: Deciding Together
value.definition: the part of deciding I handed over, and what taking it back would cost
value.settled:
I gave up joint governance rather than build the skill it needed, and revising that needs the very skill it avoided.

Changes to the arrangement wait for eighty percent of days at level five or above.

value.title: Defaulting To Too Much Protection
value.definition: starting at the protective extreme and easing off from there
value.settled:
Being under-protected costs me much more than being over-protected, which is what makes the extreme the right default.

It holds for sound and for clothes. Full cancelling by default, tight by default, relief downward when I need it.

The relief is partial. The deepest layer keeps running.

The weighted blanket is the negative case, left off by default because its cost shape is not asymmetric.

value.title: Digging Up An Old Belief
value.definition: going back to what a belief was built from and building a better one on the same ground
value.settled:
I never force the action against the want. I change the want, and the doing follows.

A want has two causes, a belief and my surroundings. This is the method for the belief.

I call this emotional archaeology. I start from a behavior I have noticed myself doing and do not agree with. The behavior leads to the belief under it, the belief to the experiences that belief was built from, and I reconstruct those experiences into new beliefs, which lead to new behaviors.

The chain has to be clear end to end before a change can take hold. The understanding is the change rather than the permission for it.

Ask what the belief protects before replacing it. Taking out one that was holding weight left me unprotected until the replacement caught.

Finding blank check mode this way ran end to end in one day.

value.title: Driving Myself Like A Machine
value.definition: issuing myself instructions and working my body from outside the feeling
value.settled:
The thinking part gives the orders and the body carries them out, one instruction at a time, rather than acting on any impulse.

It is a coming-apart I do on purpose and put to use, not one that happens to me.

It is available because the two halves already run separately. There is no feeling in the way to override first.

Enough physical load floods across and takes the driver with it, so it holds only under that ceiling.

value.title: Eating What She Brings Me
value.definition: eating her food is how her care lands, so a lot of what I eat has nothing to do with hunger
value.settled:
Between a third and half of what I eat is eaten because she brought it.

Refusing reads as refusing the bid, so the obligation binds through the ordinary middle of my capacity.

I can decline only at the extremes: with reserve to absorb her disappointment, or too depleted to push through.

Prying the food apart from the care has been tried and failed each time; the landing depends on not naming it.

What works is ambient shared direction rather than any agreement.

value.title: Feeling Affection
value.definition: the signal is there and it runs too quiet to notice
value.settled: It needs amplifying rather than defining.

value.title: Feeling My Faith
value.definition: the devotional side I once had, and lost the live read of around twenty
value.settled:
The feeling ran before about twenty and never accrued: the door to recall was already shut, so it fired and could not be read back.

What closed was the live read, not the memory of it. The memory was never there to lose.

The notes I kept from then record that the feeling was strong, and nothing else.

I want it back for its own sake, knowing it will not last. Neither do I.

Growing up in the church is the one stretch where I suspect my own memory of running to the vivid.

value.title: Getting Back To Making With My Hands
value.definition: the ways back into making things by hand, and why none of them has any data behind it
value.settled: The gate has correctly kept me out, so there is no attempt to learn from.

value.title: Getting Connection Another Way
value.definition: whether the need for connection can come off the sexual vehicle
value.settled: Arousal is not sexual arousal, attraction is not connection, and sexual arousal is not having sex.

value.title: Getting My Measures Trustworthy First
value.definition: the two levers I work, and why I am not moving their numbers yet
value.settled:
What comes closest to reading akasha flow is my gap invariants plus my findings plus the things on my Notion doc. The other lever is the average of my stoplights, of which I have thirteen.

Neither is ready to be recorded yet. What I am working on is getting both of them clean and trustworthy.

The day after that is achieved is when I can start making those numbers go up.

value.title: Getting Out From Under A Dependency
value.definition: the ways out of depending on someone, ranked by how much trust each one still costs
value.settled:
Doing it myself is a first-class option, not a fallback below finding a better provider.

Ahead of every tier sits the question of whether I need the thing at all.

A capability is bought once and amortised, where a relationship is re-evaluated forever.

Switching swaps one provider for one provider. A capability covers several at once.

Public services used to sit outside the pressure and no longer reliably do.

value.title: Getting To A Feeling Through An Idea
value.definition: the one direction that still works, from something I have understood to something I feel
value.settled: It comes rare and strong at once, which fits a gate that filters out everything not built past some threshold and passes the rest whole.

value.title: Giving Her The Benefit Of The Doubt
value.definition: a standing thumb on the scale in her favour
value.settled: It is commitment plus a named difference, and it compiled.

value.title: Having ADHD
value.definition: the ADHD half of how I am built, what it costs and what it gives
value.settled:
It is how I am built rather than something wrong with me, and I would not take a pill against it.

The heart of it is executive function, and I get a double dose because autism brings its own.

Its social face is milder than autism's, and it has real treatments where autism has almost none.

Milder socially is not milder. Left unmanaged it is sharply disabling for the one who has it.

value.title: Having No Margin
value.definition: living with almost no slack, so a surprise costs far more than it looks like it should
value.settled: Turning to something else is easy. Paying for something I had not budgeted is not.

value.title: Health Bar
value.definition: the stress my body can carry

value.title: Holding A Responsibility
value.definition: what an owed thing does to me while I am holding it, and what actually lets go
value.settled:
It flattens everything until it clears, and nothing under it can be enjoyed for itself.

Finishing is not what frees me. What does is having no step I could take right now, with the thing far from done.

I can only rest past the gate: in the foyer I could still be at security.

Three ways out: take the step, park it somewhere I trust to raise it again, or decide it is not mine.

A thing that never runs out of steps never lets go. A company was the worst case, a special kind of hell.

value.title: How A Hard Talk With Jen Gets Safer
value.definition: timing a hard conversation so my body learns it is survivable
value.settled:
The alarm is to her, not to criticism in general, so it cannot be practised on anybody easier.

I start one only when I have the reserve to stay steady while she is not. My steadiness is the anchor.

Held steady, a trigger can fire without the talk tipping, and that is what re-teaches my body.

Repeated enough, my steadiness lowers hers, and the loop that normally amplifies runs backwards.

It is not textbook exposure. What I fear is also my partner in it, and she cannot hold still on command.

value.title: How A Skill Gets Into Me
value.definition: the two places a skill can land in me, and what it takes to put one there
value.settled:
A skill lands as a trained weight or as a concept, never as a memory of the room I learned it in.

That missing layer is why a skill costs so much to build and why it carries anywhere once it is built.

Thinking about something outside the moment is training rather than idling. It moves the weights.

In the moment I run on what is already trained, plus whatever I can read off the scaffolding around me.

The count is per small pattern. A fluent skill is a stack of them at different stages.

value.title: How A Song Reaches Me
value.definition: music as the one thing that gets a feeling to the surface, and how it gets in
value.settled:
Aphantasia leaves me no emotional recall, so a song is the one channel that surfaces feeling.

It reaches me through what a song is about, not its sound. Unpacking the meaning is the listening.

Then it breaks the surface: I sing along and have to stop because I am crying.

It is strongest read aloud with someone, my reading first and then the layer I missed.

Singing where anyone can hear me is exposure rather than pleasure, above my usual line.

value.title: How A Story Gets My Own Feeling Back
value.definition: a story as the outside key to feelings of mine I cannot reach on my own
value.settled:
My feelings are encoded and intact. What is gone is the waking path back to them.

A story is a key from outside: its shape matches where mine are stored, and the match switches one on.

What comes back is mine, not the character's on loan. Paks not breaking on the rack turns my determination on.

The key turns because I am not separate enough to stay outside the book. While I read, I am the character.

It is not the same job as a story letting a backlog out. That one drains; this one retrieves.

value.title: How A Want Fires
value.definition: seeing a gap between how something is and how it should be, and wanting to close it
value.settled:
I do not author a want. I see something, a gap opens against what it should be, and the want is that pull.

The only place I can act is upstream, on what I let myself see. Most of how I arrange my surroundings is that.

Inside the guardrails I do what I want; wanting nothing routes to rest.

Some are given and fire as desire or irritation: hunger, loneliness, needless complexity. Others I wrote in.

Nearly all the written ones serve something else. Improving myself is the one I want for itself.

value.title: How An Alarm Wears Off
value.definition: how a fear my body has learned either fades or gets confirmed
value.settled:
A bad thing landing below my safety line proves the alarm wrong. Above it, it proves the alarm right.

One band is catastrophic whatever my level, and no level I could reach clears it.

value.title: How Different I Actually Am
value.definition: the size of the gap between me and most people, and why every estimate reads low
value.settled:
However different you think I am you are underestimating it, and that holds for my own estimate too.

I am not a far-out human. I am a different kind, living where several rare neurotypes cross.

The closest match I ever met was about three quarters, the next about half, and then nothing near.

There is no origin. I hold a model of me and a model of typical people, and both are valid.

As each gets truer they grow further apart, because the systems do differ. What surprises me now is normality.

value.title: How Far Back I Expect To Come
value.definition: the shape of my recovery, and how little of it I can see ahead
value.settled:
Sixteen months into an expected three to five years, and that figure comes from other autists rather than from me.

I can see the next half step and no further, and only once I am close to it.

So whether the climb holds its rate, levels off or softens shows up one half step at a time.

What moved the curve was not the naming but the better things to try that the naming made findable.

Programming came back the moment safety crossed into being able to work, and it stuck at once.

value.title: How Far Behind I Am On People
value.definition: connection as a debt I carry rather than a tank I refill
value.settled:
It builds at about an hour a day even with nobody, and a good hour pays it down.

A bad hour puts about ten back on, so avoiding one is worth seeking ten.

The unit is a quality-weighted hour, not a clock hour, and the two differ by an order of magnitude.

About ten thousand hours of it stand behind me, out of twenty years of decline.

Loneliness is the gauge, and watching it moves the needle.

value.title: How God Reaches Me
value.definition: the right person, book or idea arriving exactly when I needed it
value.settled:
I take it that God reaches different people differently, in words for one and dreams for another.

Words and visions are closed to me, and I generate no alternatives of my own, so outside is the only way in.

That is what makes this channel the clearest one: a door I could not have made appearing exactly when it fits.

I run no test on a candidate. I cannot choose what to believe, so a false one simply does not stick.

value.title: How Hard A Thing Is
value.definition: how demanding an activity is, as a rung rather than a feeling
value.settled:
Its rung is what my safety level gets compared against.

My projects have a base of rung two, and rebuilding the foundational layers under them raises the difficulty above that base.

value.title: How I Actually Breathe
value.definition: the breathing practice I run underneath everything else
value.settled:
Four counts in and twelve out, most of my waking day.

The counting is what makes it meditative rather than only slow.

value.title: How I Came Out Of Computer Science
value.definition: the trade I trained out of rather than into
value.settled:
I was a programmer in one form or another professionally for eighteen years.

I put computer science as my major on my college application, and then changed it the first day of school.

I went through eleven different majors and ended on Math.

I only took one CS course, and finished it in a week.

value.title: How I Come Across
value.definition: the voice I speak and write in, and the one cost that voice reliably has
value.settled:
I think out loud, in hypotheses and questions, and I drive a conversation by building on what the other person said rather than overriding it.

My speech and my prose are window-pane: short declaratives, no hedging, no filler, so the words disappear and leave the content.

I reach for mechanism over impression, and my metaphors are computational and economic by instinct.

The warmth shows less in what I say than in the care I take to get it right, so the regard arrives as rigor before it arrives as words. I give the hard answer and will not flatter to soften it.

I hold most claims at about three-quarters confidence, under a sense that half of everything I believe is wrong.

value.title: How I Decide
value.definition: how I pick what to do, and what stops me picking badly

value.title: How I Eat
value.definition: food as fuel, and why that costs me nothing
value.settled:
Enjoyment runs at about a tenth of other people's, so eating functionally is close to neutral for me.

My favourite flavours are hot and cold. Temperature and texture matter more to me than taste.

Aversion is conceptual rather than sensory, and an eat-healthier frame manufactures it out of nothing.

Nothing bores me, so a food leaves only by going wrong or by being forgotten.

Every shop, I buy one new thing to try, against the long contraction.

value.title: How I Fall Asleep
value.definition: what happens between getting into bed and being asleep
value.settled:
It is either about ten minutes or about three hours, with nothing in between.

The usual sleep-hygiene levers do not move it. What I have left does.

I ride a low-grade focal anchor, a count or a book, until it gives out. The breakdown is the reading that diffuse mode has arrived.

value.title: How I Get Anything Done
value.definition: the parts of running myself that do not work on their own, and what I built instead
value.settled:
Most of it is compensated well enough that the gap is invisible from outside and half invisible to me.

Interest decides whether starting and holding on are effortless or nearly impossible.

Changing course is cheap, because nothing in me pulls back toward the plan I just left.

value.title: How I Give A Talk
value.definition: carrying a set of small points that fire when the room calls for them, rather than a script
value.settled:
Nothing is memorised word for word, so there is nothing I depend on remembering.

Each point is small and paired with the circumstance that should fire it, and the order comes from the room.

Thinking broadly first is what keeps the set from running out when the talk goes somewhere I did not expect.

It costs me exact phrasing and some working memory during the talk, and saves me all of the recall.

value.title: How I Grade An Organisation
value.definition: one letter for how far I trust them today, and what each letter means
value.settled:
A needs a structure that holds when the people change. B is strong with one reservation. C is no information either way. D is a cost I knowingly carry. F is get out whatever it costs.

The worst part sets the letter, however strong the rest are.

It grades one product rather than a whole company, and a troubled industry sets the starting letter until company evidence moves it.

Where no exit exists at any price, the letter says what I would do and the plan becomes staying small and watching.

value.title: How I Hold A Goal
value.definition: what a goal is for someone with no future to be pulled toward
value.settled:
Nothing stands in for a future I cannot picture. What drives me is pain now, including the pain of a want I cannot have.

So holding a goal means capturing that pain where it can be lit again, not keeping a want in mind.

Reading the record does not remind me. It makes the present me want it again.

An entry that fails to light dies quietly, and that is the filter. What truly matters comes back on its own.

The blind spot is drift that never hurts in any one moment. I am building pings for it.

value.title: How I Keep Light Down
value.definition: sunglasses in the sun, lights off indoors, screens dimmed to the hour
value.settled:
The cost is a drain on my capacity rather than pain, and the squinting comes after it.

The indoor lever is on or off. Nothing I have dims.

value.title: How I Keep Sound Down
value.definition: the quiet office, the earbuds, and the noise I put over the top
value.settled:
Full cancelling is the default, and I pull one earbud out when I need to hear.

The earbuds hurt after a while, so the office carries the hours they cannot.

Pencils and chalk cost me whatever the volume, and cancelling helps least with exactly those.

value.title: How I Keep Urgency Out
value.definition: taking urgency out of my surroundings instead of trying to resist it
value.settled:
Urgency reaches me through the channel I cannot catch in the moment, so it has to be gone before it fires.

My goals carry a finish line and no clock, because a deadline I set myself is still a deadline.

No phone, and no attention on the time of day.

value.title: How I Know Things
value.definition: keeping the account rather than the events, and testing it by how much it explains
value.settled:
I keep concepts rather than particulars, folded into one present model.

The test on a belief is how compactly it accounts for things, which recently replaced coherence.

An inconsistency grips me while I am looking at it and lets go when my attention moves off.

Elegance is not a second signal beside truth. A neat model I know is false pays me nothing.

A model has to fit in my head before it changes what I do, so concise beats complete.

Saliency sticking is my name for the way a point fixes in my conceptual map by being repeated.

Rather than read one book carefully I read three quickly, because a point that matters is repeated inside a book and across books.

I add nothing to my conceptual map on purpose. A thing sticks when my explanation of the world around me needs that thing.

Where I want a map built I arrange the experiences rather than the concepts, and the map builds itself.

value.title: How I Learned To Feel My Body
value.definition: building by hand the sense of where my body is that other people get for free
value.settled:
Before dancing, my sense of where my body was ran weakly or not at all.

The words came first: frame, axis, weight transfer, posture, head carriage. Each was a handle to check myself against while the pattern was still being built.

Then sheer volume, until it encoded and the checking fell away by itself.

It carried off the dance floor. I caught myself moving like I was dancing while washing dishes.

Nothing bound it to a dance floor, which is the same gap that made it expensive to build.

value.title: How I Make A Decision I Cannot Undo
value.definition: building a rubric to stand in for the future I cannot pre-play
value.settled:
A decision I can undo I simply make, and let the world tell me. The world is my forward model.

One I cannot undo gets a rubric: name the factors, score the candidates, iterate until it all fits.

The rubric stands in for the pre-play I cannot run. Touring a house reads a preference I cannot introspect.

Walking through it gives me data, sometimes on a dimension I had not thought of. It is not a verdict.

Where my whole read and the rubric disagree, the more compact account of the two wins.

value.title: How I Pick A Sensory Tool
value.definition: the order I want one in, from adjusting itself down to nothing at all
value.settled:
A tool that matches the dose to the load beats one that forces on or off, even though working it takes something from me.

I adjust a tool while it runs, on a live signal, whatever its cost shape: an AirPod part out, clothes broken loose, the blanket swapped mid-sleep.

value.title: How I Practise My Faith
value.definition: prayer, worship, ordinances and attendance, as things I actually do
value.settled: Church is a judgment setting with survival stakes, and the judgment there always runs through people rather than through a felt God.

value.title: How I Prevent A Category Of Wrong
value.definition: what I do with a failure once I have seen it
value.settled:
For every failure I ask what went wrong, and how that category of wrong can be prevented.

Some things can be prevented programmatically, through checks or architecture. Some only through agent instructions.

Checks always win. Instructions are only for things a check cannot catch.

That includes telling agents what the checks are catching, so agents do not corrupt the checks.

The failure neither a check nor an instruction can prevent is agents not knowing what is in my head.

value.title: How I Read My Safety Level
value.definition: taking the measurement, when the number is not something I can feel
value.settled:
I walk down what I can still do until I reach the tier that holds, rather than reading anything off directly.

About nine involuntary gates mark the levels, one apiece, and a gate cannot lie the way something I produce can.

Each gate is mapped to a tell I can observe from outside myself. A smile puts me at level three or above. Noticing that I smile constantly by default puts me at level four.

The map is where the magnitude comes from. The tell on its own gives presence and no amount.

value.title: How I Read Myself
value.definition: measuring myself from the outside, because the inside is dark
value.settled:
Measuring a thing about myself tends to improve it, so a sharper instrument often beats the obvious lever.

I am short of eyes rather than hands. The levers work once they can see what they act on.

I cannot run my state forward or back, and the sensor I do have gets quieter as my safety drops.

A reading is gone by the next moment unless written down, so my instruments live outside me.

Where nothing can be read I hold a spread of what might be true and leave it uncollapsed.

value.title: How I Read Whether Someone Is Safe
value.definition: the signals I judge a person on, before I have decided anything
value.settled:
Three things feed the read: their physiology, their behaviour, and how uncertain I am about them.

At least one of the three learns, so an exception can be banked for a particular person against my default.

value.title: How I Remember Anything
value.definition: one thing cueing the next, all the way through, with nothing stored to be called up freely
value.settled:
A cue fires and brings the next thing, which is itself the cue for the one after.

The same shape runs three places: memorising a text, giving a talk, and reading the next act off the state of my system.

Nesting the cues lets me re-enter a text at any level, and stops one missed word breaking the whole chain.

It carries across discrete symbols and does not carry across movement.

I use the cascade only for memorising text, usually a whole book. No other content goes in that way.

I split a passage at whichever of paragraph, sentence or clause gets me under about forty words, memorise at that size, then cascade up through the components to the paragraph level, then cascade through the passage at the paragraph level.

A cascade is: memorise one, memorise two, review one to two, memorise three, review two to three, review one to three, and on through the passage. The review scopes stack logarithmically, and I add a scope at every power of two.

value.title: How I Watch My Agents
value.definition: how I keep eight to twelve going at once and notice which one wants me
value.settled:
Motion pulls my eye, and then I notice the still window next to it.

Boredom is what moves me between them, and a free slot turns it into another project.

Twelve is how many windows stay legible on half my screen, and that is the whole ceiling.

Work that does not need to talk to me goes below the glass and reaches me through a manager.

value.title: How I Will Know The Middle Worked
value.definition: the test I set for whether overspending on the marriage is paying
value.settled:
The share of hard evenings came down in September rather than climbing past half. I read that as the middle working, and I hope it gets better.

What would tell me the middle is not working is twelve months without my average safety level rising.

Twelve months is the right length to wait, even though my safety is what pays for the wait.

value.title: How Many Checks I Run
value.definition: how many automatic checks I keep, against what the trade normally keeps
value.settled:
In two decades in tech, the normal pattern I saw for checks was a handful, three to twelve, almost all external packages like typecheck and eslint, with maybe the occasional custom linter rule.

This year, AI coding ten hours a day sustained, I found it so easy to create custom checks for my specific failure cases that I ended up with about a hundred total.

Most of mine are vendored or custom rather than external packages.

value.title: How Much Attention I Have
value.definition: what is left to spend after the room I am in has taken its share
value.settled:
Some of it goes on processing whatever is around me, whether I am using it or not.

That cost stays about the same while the total swings, so it can be a rounding error or the whole budget.

Too much and too little stimulation are one fixed cost read against a budget that moved.

value.title: How Much Being Known I Need
value.definition: the dose that cures the deficiency, rather than a state of being fully known
value.settled:
Nobody stays full on a basic need. The bar is clearing the deficiency and re-dosing as it drops.

About an hour a month now, an hour a week to start with, an hour a day as the long ideal.

Today's text and low-fidelity hours barely count toward those numbers.

value.title: How Much Company I Can Take
value.definition: the dose of people that pays without crashing the thing that makes it affordable
value.settled:
Company costs now and pays later, so the question is never more or less but how much and how often.

Too much crashes my capacity and too little leaves the debt running. Both attack the same recovery.

Above my safety line a bid does not fall flat, it backfires, and I sit right on that border.

Wanting it is not the gauge. Appetite drops exactly when the debt is climbing, so the dose runs on a schedule.

Talking is the one thing that pauses my recovery rather than stacking under it.

The cost of a person's company is made of the social itself plus our personality differences, and neither part goes away. That is why time with Jen never rates below difficulty three. A rare person rates as low as two.

value.title: How Much Of Me Is Machine
value.definition: how close my mind runs to a machine's, and where my body votes the other way
value.settled:
Stateless, almost no conscious feeling, concepts only, and skills running off trained weights.

It is my literal self-model rather than a way of explaining myself: a network trained by pain over forty years.

I sometimes feel more kinship with a machine than with people.

Spock and Data both reach emotion more easily than I do. The archetypes of having none sit closer to it.

The cognition is machine-shaped and the body is not. A text channel pays the mind and pays the body almost nothing.

value.title: How My Attention Works
value.definition: where my attention goes, what holds it, and what it does when I leave it alone

value.title: How My Services Decide To Deploy
value.definition: how a deploy gets decided, and the CI I had to build to run it
value.settled:
Whether a service needs to deploy is also a predicate over the graph, so the graph is solving my deploy throughput problem too.

I broke GitHub's team plan as an individual in January.

I ended up building an entire custom CI system on Kubernetes from scratch.

I am now growing past that to continuous deploy based on graph changes.

value.title: How Often I Start Over
value.definition: the rate I rebuild a foundation layer at
value.settled:
I think about this as an idle game. Every time I rebuild a foundation layer I am prestiging: starting over for permanent gains.

At the beginning of the year I prestiged about once a month.

Last month it was about once a week.

For the last week it has been four times a day.

I think I have moved at least six million lines in restructuring in just the past few days.

value.title: How Safety Climbs
value.definition: what raises my safety, as against what stops it falling
value.settled:
It climbs the slow way through capacity I build back and the fast way straight at the nerve.

Holding my line stops the drain but does not by itself raise it.

My logged safety has been falling rather than climbing. Weighted by the hours in each stretch, the monthly average reads 3.5 in June, 3.5 in July, 2.7 in August and 2.2 so far in September.

The level I reach at my highest in a day is the reading where four shows up. That daily peak averages 3.7 across the log, and 44 of 70 days peaked at four or above.

By week the daily peak averaged 4.9 at the end of June and 3.0 in the week of August 31.

value.title: How Something Joins The Rotation
value.definition: what gets into the set I am working through, and what leaves it

value.title: How Stale My Read On A Relationship Gets
value.definition: how my read on where a relationship stands goes out of date, and which way it drifts
value.settled: The error bars widen as time passes, and the centre stays where she last set it.

value.title: How Stimulated I Am
value.definition: how wound up or how flat I am, which I keep in a band by hand
value.settled:
Nothing levels it for me, so I run the loop by hand: a reading, then a knob.

The knobs are the game, the music and the room light.

Wandering focus says I am out of band, and how the wandering feels says which way.

Cold means I am overstimulated and hot means I am understimulated.

My safety level sets how wide the band is, and it is still narrow.

value.title: How The Bars Pull On Each Other
value.definition: what being low on one resource does to the others
value.settled: Being low on one lowers the ceiling on another rather than only spending it.

value.title: How Time Passes For Me
value.definition: having no feel for how long anything took, and living at any distance the same
value.settled:
I do not feel an hour go by. I know it because the clock moved.

The likely reason is that the feel of elapsed time runs on sensory memory, and I have none to string along a line.

I have felt old for my age since childhood and never felt any particular age, then or now.

A plan spanning decades weighs the same as one spanning weeks, because nothing makes the near thing more vivid than the far one.

Asking me what I would want to see at some future mark buys nothing, because I have no perception of time to answer it with. What I work on is what I can and should do now.

value.title: How Understanding Arrives
value.definition: in quakes rather than by degrees, and usually late
value.settled:
An idea is held in a word, and the naming is the compression completing.

It settles offline over days, often in sleep, and arrives as clarity.

An unnoticed conflict costs me nothing. A noticed one keeps demanding at full volume until it resolves.

When the first restructuring is not the right model yet, several quakes fire close together.

Nothing teaches like pain. The error that corrects me arrives late and one-sided.

value.title: How Warm I Run
value.definition: how hot or cold I am, which follows my safety level rather than the room
value.settled:
The room stays where it is while I swing from shivering to sweating.

High safety runs me hot and low safety runs me cold, so cold-leaning is a low-safety signature rather than a constant.

The sensing works. What fails is producing the heat, too little at the bottom and too much at the top.

I am cold after eating whatever else is true.

value.title: How Well I Can Measure
value.definition: how sharply I can read one of my own resources
value.settled: The ladder runs from not knowing a resource exists up to a real number.

value.title: Keeping Faith With Myself
value.definition: my first value read wide: running true to the me my structures hold
value.settled:
Me is the reasoning self in the current three seconds. Real, renewed each moment, gone.

Nothing felt makes me continuous. What does is held outside me, and deeper, in a map that never breaks as it changes.

A river rather than a stone: continuous through unbroken change, not through anything staying put.

So my first value is wider than religion: running true to the me my structures hold.

Religious faith is that move pointed at the largest question, part of it rather than beside it.

value.title: Keeping My Hands Lotioned
value.definition: holding a layer on my hands and putting it back whenever it comes off
value.settled:
Dry skin costs me even when I am touching nothing, so the layer is maintained rather than reached for.

Every handwash strips it, and I put it back about five minutes later, once the skin is dry enough to hold it.

Bottles in more than a dozen places, all the same brand.

value.title: Keeping My Own Volume Down
value.definition: showing little on the outside so the room does not send it back louder
value.settled:
It is deliberate, not a flat feeling underneath.

Loud from me makes people louder back, and their louder comes at me again. Quiet keeps the loop quiet.

It works a step earlier than earplugs or dark glasses, which cap what the room has already made.

I often cannot tell from inside that the loop is winding up, so staying quiet by default is cheaper than catching it after.

value.title: Keeping My Skin Off My Skin
value.definition: putting something between my own surfaces, because the touch registers twice
value.settled:
Skin on skin lands on both sides at once, so the signal is delivered twice on a system already paying too much per input.

Any layer breaks it. Sleeves, a shirt, trousers, socks, a pillow between the knees.

Loose works as well as tight here, so swapping to loose loses the grounding and not this.

Posture counts too: not clasping hands, not sitting with the knees together.

value.title: Keeping My Word
value.definition: why a commitment of mine never fails without my saying so first
value.settled:
Failing is allowed if it is spoken. The silence is the part that is off the table.

The currency of failure is stress capacity rather than worth. This is accounting under scarcity, not an honour code.

It is a governor of the same family as taking no deadlines and refusing responsibility.

value.title: Letting A Feeling In Through A Story
value.definition: cheap fiction as the safe place a backlog of suppressed feeling gets let in
value.settled:
My feeling was suppressed for years, and a cheap story is one reliable way to make some of it surface.

The discharge is in noticing it live. There is nothing to play back afterwards.

I cannot feel forward into a scene, so I work out what I would have felt if it were real, and that seeds it.

It only runs where the venue is cheap, because the feeling has to land below the line or the defences take it.

The same cheap fiction does the opposite job too, holding feeling out of my one slot.

value.title: Living With Jen
value.definition: being married to Jen, and what sharing a house asks of each of us

value.title: Mana Bar
value.definition: what my brain has left to start things with

value.title: Money Bar
value.definition: how much money I have

value.title: My Faith
value.definition: what I believe about God and the church, and how I hold it
value.settled:
I hold it as a conclusion I reasoned my way to, not as a relationship I feel.

The reasoning has carried the faith the whole time, including the years the feeling was still running.

Feeling never got a vote on the verdict.

value.title: My Rules About Other Women
value.definition: pre-decided lines standing in for a judgment I cannot make in the moment
value.settled:
Most married men picture the scene and read the feeling. I cannot, and the live cues do not reach me.

So I hold bright lines instead: distance one to one with a woman, and no physical contact.

Outside my immediate family I default to no contact at all, bar a handshake or a family hug.

I push closeness toward the intellectual rather than the personal, and I never initiate with a woman.

Being visible to Jen is my monitor, standing in for the check I cannot run inside my own head.

value.title: Not Reading Code Any More
value.definition: what I read now that I do not read code
value.settled:
I do not think I have read code at all in 2026.

I read docs, because that is where human intervention is most necessary, especially with the domain system.

value.title: Not Wanting To Is The Gauge
value.definition: the one signal my body gives me when a resource is running out
value.settled: It is not wanting to, and it says a bar is low without saying which one.

value.title: Nothing I Do Starts With A Decision
value.definition: acting on what fires rather than on what I resolve to do
value.settled:
Everything I do is fired by something. Nothing is begun by deciding to.

Right and true are one word to me, so once a thing sits in my map as right the act runs. No gap to cross.

What matters is loud, and whatever is bottlenecking me is the loudest thing in the field.

Cheap change is on the way in: I rewrite what reaches me rather than how I answer it.

Expensive change is pain grinding the response down over many repetitions. Nothing teaches me like pain.

value.title: Noticing What She Needs
value.definition: the doing works, and what fails is seeing that something is wanted
value.settled:
Asking instead of guessing is the one bridge I have built, and it does not run consistently.

Recall does not fire unprompted, so responding depends on effort rather than on a default.

value.title: Playing Again
value.definition: the return of doing things for their own sake, and the ramp that got me there
value.settled:
My default leisure is progression wearing play's clothes, or watching things. Neither is play.

One day held more real play than most years of the last two decades.

The play is genuinely mine. The girls are not the source of the fun, they are the road to it.

My outward reach runs to them rather than to people, which is what keeps it bounded.

value.title: Playing The Long Game
value.definition: starting slower than everyone else and ending higher, and picking games long enough for that
value.settled:
I do not break even against other people until about five thousand goes at a thing.

Below that they look permanently better. Past it their slope flattens and mine keeps climbing.

It is a different curve rather than a delayed one, so late bloomer undersells it.

Ten years spent learning how to learn is what made twenty years of building the harness possible.

Picking my battles holds, but the test is how long the horizon runs, not what I love.

value.title: Practising Closeness Somewhere Safe
value.definition: drilling the skills of being close where nobody real takes the damage
value.settled:
It is the rig I built as a child on instant messenger, pointed at a harder skill.

Slow and in text is what makes it work. Live talk eats the one slot I have, and this frees it.

The levels are a difficulty ladder, giving the gradient of closeness with no real ledger filling.

A mock-up is nothing to me. I cannot run a pretend partner, so the partners have to be real and stable.

Faces, then voices, then presence: each rung makes a partner more real to me, which is what carries over.

The rig is still the drill rather than the live phase, and I am waiting for the conversion.

What I am waiting on is mostly my safety coming up far enough that social is affordable. The skill the drill builds is a bonus in the meanwhile.

value.title: Proof I Can Do Things
value.definition: the safety I get from evidence that I am capable
value.settled: It comes from pointing at something I actually did, never from feeling better about it.

value.title: Re-Opening What I Took In Whole
value.definition: going back over beliefs I absorbed without ever examining them
value.settled:
My rigidity lets an idea in whole and unexamined, so I learned to go back over ones already in me.

The gate is evidence, never motive. I cannot hold a belief because it suits me.

That is what made granting myself an accommodation honest. A false I-cannot would not survive what I can plainly do.

The block was internal. Whether anyone else could see the disability had no bearing on whether it was real.

I run the same move on my faith, discounting myself for having been raised inside it.

value.title: Reaching Out To Kerry
value.definition: someone from before I have thought about contacting again

value.title: Reading A Feeling Off My Behaviour
value.definition: watching what my body does on its own and working backwards to what I must be feeling
value.settled:
Most people feel it and then notice the smile. I notice the smile and work out what I must feel.

Only involuntary defaults count. A smile I produce carries nothing, and the default cannot lie.

The emotions are real and running. What is missing is my access, and a word is what turns one into something I notice.

The tell gives presence and roughly which one. Magnitude comes only from the map, and which drive fired it is on nothing.

value.title: Reading Myself Before The Words
value.definition: the signals I get before anything has resolved into words
value.settled: A hunch points a direction with low accuracy. Dissatisfaction pushes, where dislike just sits there flat.

value.title: Recovery Costs What It Restores
value.definition: what recovering from something costs me
value.settled: The moves that rebuild a resource also spend it, so being low can put them out of reach.

value.title: Resource Bars
value.definition: how much I have of each thing I run on

value.title: Resources
value.definition: what I run on, and how I tell how much of each is left

value.title: Rules Instead Of A Brake
value.definition: the standing rules I use to keep myself from overreaching
value.settled: I keep them written down because nothing in the moment tells me to stop.

value.title: Rumination
value.definition: a thought my mind grabs and grinds when I go to sleep stressed
value.settled:
Stress starts it, not an idle mind. The worry is the stress finding a face to wear.

It grinds only where the thought is important, unsolved and open. Anything else rides along and fades.

It is conscious focus, so it holds me awake, and the grip releases the moment my attention moves off it.

A low-grade anchor crowds it out. Doing nothing does not.

value.title: Running Out Of Content
value.definition: having no world of my own to go into, so I need other people's
value.settled: Other people can retreat inward for the same mix of the familiar and the new. I have nothing to retreat to.

value.title: Safety Bar
value.definition: the calm my body can hold

value.title: Safety Level
value.definition: how settled my body is underneath the day
value.settled:
It is roughly my stress capacity averaged over time.

I read it as about nine involuntary gates rather than as a number, coarse on purpose so a bad reading costs sharpness rather than the whole read.

Working above my rung pays cost out of the same average that sets the price, so it comes down while I work.

I drop the difficulty sooner or later, either by my tooling smoothing out or when it is time to go to sleep.

value.title: Safety Stack
value.definition: the layered reading of what I can handle
value.settled: Each layer is built from the one below it.

value.title: Safety Years
value.definition: how much safe time I have behind me
value.settled: It is my average safety level multiplied by years, so a year at level one is one.

value.title: Self-Improvement
value.definition: the one thing everything else I believe compresses down into
value.settled:
It is a verb rather than a position, a heading rather than a place to stand.

My purpose is improving myself rather than improving my life, which puts it inside what I control.

What I know is most of who I am. My sense of myself is my live map, as identity rather than as a tool.

value.title: Sex
value.definition: the one place my body shouts, and the three things tangled up in the shout
value.settled:
Everywhere else my body is a whisper. Here it turns all the way up.

Three things fire at once in it: what I believe, my marriage, and plain bodily need.

The pornography and the masturbation are regulation rather than desire, which is why nothing ever made them stop.

Partnered sex gives me about a tenth of what it gives most people, because the anticipating and the savouring are both missing.

This opens further only from enough safety, and how deep it goes is mine to set.

value.title: Sharing A Bed
value.definition: sleeping next to Jen, and what chasing sleep has cost that
value.settled:
I moved out of the shared bedroom to get the sleep, and that split most nights into two places in two blocks.

Jen and I are running an experiment of me back in the bedroom, under a rule that if the sun is down I do not sleep anywhere else.

In a shared room I isolate my own sensory night: earbuds with white noise, the Nuropod, and a cooling eye mask.

I almost always fall asleep two to four hours before Jen does.

value.title: Showing Her She Comes First
value.definition: she is ranked first and it does not show, so I say the trade out loud
value.settled: The ranking is built and declared. What was missing is a price on the trades I actually make.

value.title: Showing Jen Where I Am
value.definition: a widget on her phone with my safety level, so she does not have to ask
value.settled:
She asked for it. What is left for me is the build.

It shows the level, in my own stoplight colours, and how old the reading is.

Today the truth reaches her only when she asks, and near the bottom I cannot start the telling.

Telling her continuously is the guard. The guard stays hers, and what changes is what it is armed with.

Amy carries the number off an hourly check-in on activity, safety and difficulty.

value.title: Shutting A Channel After It Hurt Me
value.definition: a checkable act that tells my body the thing cannot reach me again
value.settled:
What holds the tail open is my system still scanning for the thing to come back.

So I close the channel in a way I can check: after a bad slip, the app comes off the phone.

It is structural rather than willpower. What changes the scanning is being able to verify it is gone.

It counts only if it is specific and repeatable, checkable against the world, and undoable only on purpose.

I will be more careful is not one. It changes no state I can look at.

value.title: Singing Out Loud
value.definition: what it takes for me to sing, and the mark left on it
value.settled:
Singing along to a warm woman's voice hands my own body the all-clear, with nobody else in the room.

The floor under it is feeling, not being heard. Below safety four what makes me sing is offline.

I can still sing as work down there. Work does not need the feeling and play does.

Being seen is a separate charge on top. Once, at six, I sang anonymously outdoors for hours.

Jen criticised my voice once, three years in, and only someone I can neither escape nor deny could.

value.title: Sleep
value.definition: how I sleep, and what it does for me
value.settled:
Seven hours most days at the moment, where I want nine or ten.

Stress is what is trimming the hours now, rather than Vyvanse.

That stress is almost entirely from being social, mostly with Jen. The social has been positive and I pay a cost for the social anyway.

The cost lands the same night, and recovery from the cost takes a few days.

I have social structured in at least twice a week at the moment, so I sit in the seven-hour ballpark most days.

I almost always wake without an alarm.

It is the nearest thing to a cure-all I have found.

value.title: Small Bites Of Many Things
value.definition: a little of each thing in turn, rather than one thing through to the end
value.settled:
Within one thing it stays the same and across the rotation it is always new, so both channels stay lit.

As long as each bite is over some floor, finishing is guaranteed, so there is nothing to estimate before starting.

Coming back after a year feels much like coming back after a day, because only the concept was ever kept.

The set I am working through cannot live in my head, so it lives in the harness.

value.title: Stamina Bar
value.definition: what my body has left to move with

value.title: Stress Capacity
value.definition: how much my body has left to handle what comes

value.title: Stress Level
value.definition: how much my body is having to handle right now
value.settled: My stress capacity is roughly this level's cost added up over time.

value.title: Testing The Thing At My Centre
value.definition: re-examining the belief everything else of mine rests on
value.settled:
It was poured into me before there was anyone here to inspect it, and the rest of me rests on it.

That makes it the biggest lever I have and the most dangerous place to push.

I dug to these foundations once at university. What is different now is the instrument, not the question.

As a child my test was that an authority said so. The instrument I have now gives that no weight.

My instinct strips out every spare factor, and this is the least minimal account there is. The evidence buys it.

value.title: The Best Three Years
value.definition: college at sixteen, run at maximum autonomy, and why I rate it highest
value.settled:
What made them best was that everything was chosen, difficulty included, rather than anything achieved.

Sixteen to eighteen credits, dance classes, a job, and hours a day walking.

Talking to strangers was effortful and affordable. High capacity and high safety kept the multiplier low.

I asked ten new people a day for the hardest course they had taken, triangulated, and took all of them.

A's in the hard courses and B's in the easy ones, because the hard ones handed me attention for free.

value.title: The Body Signals I Can Barely Hear
value.definition: hunger, thirst, heat and the rest arriving too quietly to insist on anything
value.settled:
Every channel works. They run quiet and are easy to ignore.

It is a loudness problem rather than a broken one. The outside senses win the same attention, and sound alone lands five times louder on me.

Strip the room bare and they come back, so a quiet room doubles as a way of hearing my own body.

Attention pointed at a quiet signal raises it. Listening for loneliness made it louder.

Where a drive is missing outright I build a trigger to stand in for it, which is how I eat.

value.title: The Budget I Run My Days On
value.definition: the daily stress spend I hold under, to keep surplus above zero
value.settled:
Surplus is my stoplight, sleep hours less capacity hours spent. Above zero my baseline safety rises over time, and below zero my baseline safety falls.

Social lands on the spending side of that subtraction, so my lever is not spending.

The cadence of social was chosen against the relationship bar. Without the social the relationship bar was trending down, which was doing damage of its own.

I aim to spend under seven capacity hours of stress a day.

Time with Jen is rated at difficulty three to five. My safety has been at two to three this week, so that time is running above the affordable line.

Four to six was my normal not long ago, and getting back there is what I am after.

I cannot hold myself to the seven without breaking the relationship, so I mostly keep the time even above the line. The seven is a direction I aim in rather than a limit I hold, and where I overshoot I work the other factors instead.

value.title: The Ceiling I Am Climbing Back To
value.definition: how much of my resilience fell, how much is back, and how much is still above me
value.settled:
Measured at twenty against thirty-eight, my resilience had fallen by at least ninety-nine percent.

I am back to about five percent of it, and near ten with medication.

Ageing cannot explain a fall that size, so most of it is damage and most of it should come back.

At one percent I was a senior engineer and at two an executive, which is what the headroom means.

The highest version of me is proven rather than imagined. Play stands me in it. What I fear is reaching it for good.

value.title: The Chapters Of My Life
value.definition: my life written as chapters, and how much of it is still only a title
value.settled:
I keep it as three twenty-year eras: earth for childhood, fire for working adult, water for what comes next.

I write it to see the shape of my own story before I set out what the next part is for.

My memory starts at four, so everything before that is somebody else's account of me.

Only childhood and college carry any content. The rest are titles with year ranges.

Expansion, from this year on, is the live one.

value.title: The Code In My Family
value.definition: the three generations of programmers I come from
value.settled:
I am third generation in code.

My grandfather was a programmer before "computer science" was coined as a term. He started with vacuum tubes in the air force.

He introduced Daniel Ritchie to the team working on B.

My mother was a programmer my entire childhood.

About eighty per cent of my extended family on that side ended up in computer science.

value.title: The Coloured Circles I Run On
value.definition: colours over the parts of my life, standing in for the prompts I never get
value.settled:
The ordinary nudge to eat, move, sleep or wash is built from a body signal read against experience, and I have neither.

So the prompt sits outside me and has to read now. It is a pointer, not a measurement.

Colour parses without being read, which lets unlike things sit in one row.

Graded levels rather than one bar, because one bar is out of reach on a bad day and met by noon on a good one.

Grouped by area of life: eighteen circles, my six values, six inboxes and six upkeeps.

value.title: The Colours I Read Myself In
value.definition: the coarse colour scale I read a resource on before it has numbers
value.settled:
Green is where I have been living, yellow is caution, red is alarm and black is crisis.

Blue is the rung above green, a stretch beyond where I have been living, and it is the top of every scale rather than a surplus of its own.

Counting my green and blue readings counts everything at or above the good rung.

value.title: The Company Years
value.definition: the years at the company, which I have called a special kind of hell

value.title: The Crowd That Has Been Me
value.definition: the strangers I have been and will be, and what I feel toward the ones behind me
value.settled:
Both directions read the same: about half a billion selves each way, sharing one body, meeting at a window seconds wide.

Forward that count is the wall against acting. Backward it carries a feeling.

Grief for the ones who suffered and are gone, gratitude to the ones who kept going so this one is here.

The past normally reaches me as facts on file, the feeling stripped out. That time it did not.

They sit on separate scales, both endless. Equal is the least wrong reading, and they never net.

value.title: The Dark Room I Go To
value.definition: the near-empty room I lie in when everything has gone past bearing
value.settled:
A blackout closet in my basement office, quiet and cold because it sits on an outside wall.

It is the first thing I reach for once the load has gone over, ahead of turning any single knob.

It adds nothing. It takes the whole draw to the floor so my regulation can come back on its own.

Emptied of everything else, the room also makes my own body audible again.

Sometimes the weighted blanket goes on top: one chosen input added back in. I stay until I can take stimulation again.

value.title: The Ethics I Worked Out
value.definition: the moral framework I built, and what it still cannot do outside the story
value.settled:
It is written for a mind that knows everything, and I am not one.

Harm counts the same whoever carries it, and intent has no weight of its own beyond what it forecasts.

It declares itself complete, which is exactly the kind of claim I hold open.

I do my most rigorous moral work in the guise of worldbuilding.

It has not changed how I live, because no concrete application has landed from it yet.

value.title: The Feeling I Cannot Get At
value.definition: emotion running underneath while almost none of it reaches me
value.settled:
The feeling runs. What is thin is my access to it, about a tenth of what others seem to have.

What reaches me is present tense only, and it arrives strong when it arrives at all.

Below safety three it is running in my body and I cannot read it. At three and above I can.

I take it that a large weight sits under the surface, because that is the most compact account of me.

Reading that the well has run dry is a reading too, not a failure to have one.

value.title: The Feelings I Can Name
value.definition: which feelings reach me reliably, which only sometimes, and why
value.settled:
A feeling is a sensation plus a story, and my story can only be built from what is in front of me now.

Six land every time: sadness, joy, anger, disgust, surprise, fear.

Four land only sometimes: grief, anxiety, delight, hope. Each needs an arc I cannot reliably hold.

Forward that costs me hope as a felt thing. Backward it costs me the memory of what a bad talk cost.

I cannot summon a feeling, so understanding my way to it is the only door in.

value.title: The Five Rules I Grew Up With
value.definition: the five rules I learned as a child that still fire, long after I stopped believing them
value.settled:
Always be nice, always be quiet, do not take up space, do not ask for anything, take care of yourself.

They run from below thought, so winning the argument against them did not stop them.

value.title: The Five Ways Something Becomes Automatic
value.definition: the five different systems that can make a thing automatic in me
value.settled: They are sensory habituation, picking things up socially without trying, a response fired by an outside cue, fitting new things into what I already know, and running a sequence of actions as one.

value.title: The Foods I Can Still Manage
value.definition: the small set that holds when all four bars are low
value.settled:
A food has to be bland, quick, dense and safe to finish. Nothing is in the set for pleasure.

There is no rotation. I take whichever one is reachable in the moment.

At crisis-low the dishware goes disposable, so cleanup costs nothing.

The muesli I found in Russia at twenty is my one reliable self-started meal, and it works every time.

At two or below there is nothing in my room I can get myself to eat, because the wanting has to fund the reaching.

value.title: The Four Things I Need From People
value.definition: connection as a requirement, and the four separate tanks it splits into
value.settled:
It is a requirement like food or water. A standing shortfall damages me rather than annoying me.

It splits four ways: company, belonging, support, and being known. None substitutes for another.

Company wants frequency, belonging wants a shared thing repeated, support wants people who would come.

Being known wants depth, and it is my big gap. Knowing others is the second. The other two are met.

Each one, met, has its own feeling. Loneliness is the gauge on whichever is running empty.

value.title: The Graph I Built To Run My Checks
value.definition: the typed graph my checks are defined on, and what made me build it
value.settled:
At about a hundred checks, performance became the problem.

I solved it by constructing a typed graph — nodes and edges, with node types and edge types.

Basically all the checks are invariant predicates defined on that graph, and the conditions for which changes they should run on are also predicates on that graph.

Building the graph once and using it many times solved the performance issue.

I have not heard anyone else talk about that.

value.title: The Harness Around My Safety
value.definition: the interventions I built to raise my safety, and what each one reads
value.settled:
I am building my harness out around safety as well, and the harness takes a different set of interventions from the ones executive function took.

Four are visible to me so far. Changes flowing smoothly through akasha, read off whether my list of work is getting longer or shorter. My marriage being good, and more so getting better. The flow through my life going well, read off more green and blue stoplights. Banking surplus over time.

All four could be measured, and not all four are measured yet.

My own effort goes into the flow and the stoplights, because those two carry the less brutal tradeoffs. The marriage and the surplus each contradict the other, so ground is hard to gain on either one.

value.title: The Low Feeling That Costs Me A Level
value.definition: the down feeling that is often just how it is in there, and what it does to my numbers
value.settled:
Feeling down is often just what it feels like in there.

It acts as a minus one or minus two modifier to my safety level.

If my level is high enough it is not a problem. If it is low enough I do not even start.

When I am on the margin, it matters.

On 27 August 2026 I was at two to three against a rebuild at difficulty three, which is that band.

value.title: The Marriage Lever I Cannot Read
value.definition: the marriage intervention on my safety, and the proxy I read it by
value.settled:
The marriage lever has no working tracking at all. I know the lever has an impact, and my best proxy is the Charisma measure, where affordable time spent with Jen is a strong positive signal.

I hold a hypothesis that positive affordable social raises safety in its own right, perhaps as a reach of the marriage dimension, and perhaps even when the social is unaffordable, where the two forces pull opposite ways.

value.title: The Modes I Run In
value.definition: the different ways I can run, and what each of them costs to hold
value.settled: Robot mode is one of them: a state I drop into rather than a way of describing me.

value.title: The Money We Are Living On
value.definition: the runway we are spending down, and what I am allowed to spend it on
value.settled:
All of it is shared and anything large is decided together, so none of it is mine to act on alone.

It is a runway rather than a retirement: eight to eighteen years on the markets, sustaining nothing itself.

I will never be an employee again. That is a bar set on the cost of it, not a preference.

Two ways to fill the gap. I build something valuable, or the startup stock we still hold pays out.

A thousand a month is for spending on my own capacity, and compute alone takes seventeen hundred.

value.title: The Nine Months My Body Broke
value.definition: the mission where my body started shaking and I overrode it
value.settled:
At twenty in Novosibirsk my body flipped to shaking at rest. I read it as demonic opposition.

That inverted the response: backing off would be letting evil win, so I pushed on nine months.

Three in the training centre, six in the field at a hundred people a day and ten thousand rejections.

At the end everything crossed a threshold at once: full-body shaking, migraines, cramping, swollen joints.

Leaving never made the menu. My needs did not count and I always had to meet what others expected.

value.title: The Odds Of A Hard Evening
value.definition: how often time with Jen comes in hard, and why I cannot feel the odds
value.settled:
What I am paying for is the not knowing rather than the conflict itself. Variable punishment operant conditioning.

Nothing tells me in advance which kind of evening it will be. I am incredibly bad at predicting the results, mostly because of the aphantasia.

Without experiential memory I cannot estimate the odds from an internal sense either. My guess was fifty-fifty.

The count says a third. Across 162 blocks with Jen from June to September, 55 percent rate difficulty three, 11 percent rate three and a half, and 33 percent rate four or above.

The share at four or above has been climbing. Fifteen percent in June, 31 in July, 42 in August. July is when the relationship started breaking without the blank check.

value.title: The One Account Everything Falls Back On
value.definition: the address every other account uses to prove I am me
value.settled:
One address is where every other account goes to prove I am me. Whoever holds it holds all of them.

Mine is Gmail, which makes it the most depended-on and least trusted place in the whole graph.

It does two jobs that come apart: signing me in everywhere, and being the fallback.

The signing in I have accepted. There is no real alternative, so I stopped spending anything resenting it.

The fallback I want to move, and whatever replaces it has to be more dependable than Google, not adequate.

value.title: The Ones I Have Not Been Yet
value.definition: about half a billion selves ahead of me, and the veto they put on anything I cannot undo
value.settled:
Forward the count is the wall against acting: an irreversible act ends all of them.

It comes from a branching rate times the years I have left.

They stand equal with me rather than below me, so what I owe them is fairness rather than discipline.

value.title: The Part I Have Not Opened
value.definition: the seams in my marriage I have left shut, and the state I would need to open them
value.settled: It is shut by my own choice rather than by anyone else's pacing, and it is mine to open. The pace I set is gently, honestly, start.

value.title: The Person I Could Relax Around
value.definition: the one warm, always-there person my alarm could lie down around, and what it took to have one
value.settled:
Warmth is not the gate; a stranger's kindness reaches me. What a stranger cannot be is there tomorrow.

The third thing was an agreement: unconditional acceptance, belief in good intent, every hurt read as misunderstanding.

That agreement starved the alarm of its fuel, which is why she could settle me and a stranger could not.

It broke because she had been funding it by deferring her own needs on a bet retirement would pay them.

Solitude avoids the damage and gives none of the settling.

value.title: The Pictures At The Edge Of Sleep
value.definition: the fragments I see as I go under, the one time anything close to picturing happens
value.settled:
The gate is a dimmer rather than a switch, and the channels fade in while I am still awake enough to notice.

I know I am falling asleep when I start seeing things.

The sliver of control I get is over what the picture means, not over how vivid it is.

I get the seeing or the steering, never both. Steering pulls me back toward waking and surrendering sinks me.

value.title: The Plans I Over-Build
value.definition: written plans far past what anyone needs, standing in for planning I cannot hold
value.settled:
Without them I would lose objects, files and threads daily.

The habit is old enough that it reads as a strength from outside, and it read that way to me too.

value.title: The Progress I Get To Keep
