value.definition: the deepest and steadiest source of permanent progress I have is inside a game
value.settled:
Permanent means account, character and companion state, which cannot be taken back.

Six tiers run down from that to combat power, crafting, economic power, time efficiency and appearance. Items only carry progress and are never progress. Permanent progress always beats gold.

The hierarchy is settled and not to be re-opened.

value.title: The Proof That I Am Worth Something
value.definition: the argument I built for my own worth, and what it does not reach
value.settled:
It is a proof rather than a feeling: if any human has worth, all have it equally, so I have it.

It never claims humans have worth at all. It says only that the worth admits no exception for me.

I compiled it in the wreckage after the firing, as the tool that moment needed.

It was a crowbar, not a foundation. It broke the belief that my needs come last and asserts nothing positive.

Worth is not the currency my failures are paid in. That is stress capacity, and worth is a fossil beside it.

value.title: The Rating My Budget Rests On
value.definition: the hand-set rating my surplus number is built on, and how I keep the rating true
value.settled:
Only the clock is counted. Each stretch's duration is multiplied by how safe I was against how hard the thing was, and the safety rating is one I type and one that carries forward until I change it.

Affordable means the multiplier is one or less, which is the same as my safety level sitting at or above the difficulty level. Better again is free, where my safety level is at least one above the difficulty and the stretch costs nothing.

I try to catch the transitions as they happen. Where I miss one, I revise the safety or the difficulty afterwards.

The revision usually moves down, so my live reading runs optimistic. The optimistic reading is still better than nothing.

I am working on catching the changes earlier and on erring low.

A notification fires as my surplus color drops, and Jen gets the same alert. I do nothing when the alert lands. What the alert buys me for now is knowing where I am.

value.title: The Repeating I Do To Settle
value.definition: the movements and loops I run to keep my nervous system steady
value.settled:
Walking is the main one, lifelong: while eating, while talking, instead of driving. It does not read as stimming from outside.

Tapping a foot carries the sitting, rocking and bouncing where neither works, flapping only when I am really excited.

None of it wears out, because the input never costs less than it did.

Counting and ordering stand in for the picturing others ground themselves with.

Music, a familiar game, new books by familiar authors and coding settle me as much as the body ones.

value.title: The Rule That I May Not Spend Myself
value.definition: the hard rule standing in for a sense of self-preservation I do not have
value.settled:
As compiled: if it would hurt me I am not allowed to, even if it would help or spare others, including my future selves.

It forbids spending myself rather than pushing me to live, and stands on ethics rather than fear.

It is a floor, not a priority. Below it nothing trades; above it a future gain at no cost now is a duty.

It replaced the old rule: that I may not do what would hurt other people.

In the marriage it now reads as do less harm, the one place I could not hold the line.

value.title: The Scaffolding I Built
value.definition: the twenty years of structure I run on, holding what my head cannot
value.settled:
I am the agent and the system around me is the harness. Every tool in it is a part, not the thing.

It grows by adding rather than replacing, and a layer gets built when something buckles.

Twenty years produced two permanent organs, one on what I can track and one on what I can carry.

The two are wired together: clearing the queues lifts my safety, and low safety piles them up and drags it lower.

The task half lives in software now, a set of streams I push things out of my head into.

value.title: The Score I Keep On Myself
value.definition: points and a light on each of my values, and why that layer is my strongest lever
value.settled:
The values do not change, so the scoring on top of them is where the leverage sits.

The chain runs score, then behaviour, then safety, and safety prices everything else I can do.

The motivation is the light itself, like a notification badge: an irritant I built, as I move only on present pain.

It holds because I do not habituate, so the badge never goes quiet, which is what kills it for others.

Green stays honest: a cooler self set the bar, and I cannot believe I cleared it when I did not.

value.title: The Shape Behind The Two Lines
value.definition: the pattern Abby read under both lines, and how much of it is mine

value.title: The Stories That Buy Me A Day
value.definition: reading someone who hurt like this and lived, because hope has to arrive from outside
value.settled:
The arguments stop the act and supply no will to go on. This is where the will comes from.

Real or invented makes no difference. What counts is that someone who hurt like this got through.

I cannot picture a better future and feel it from inside, so hope cannot be made in here. It has to arrive as a record that survival happened to someone.

It is not the same job as cheap fiction letting a backlog out. That one drains and this one carries.

value.title: The Things I Never Weigh
value.definition: obligations filed as compulsory, so what they cost never reaches them
value.settled:
Some obligations never reach the sums. They are filed as must, and the sums run on what is left.

The filing came from family, church and culture. Nobody chose it, so it stopped looking like a filing.

No amount of better budgeting reaches a thing filed that way. The filing has to open first.

I open one by saying it aloud: I treat this as a must because. Where the because is I always have, it moves.

Asking to be released from my church calling is the case. Once it opened, the sums cut it.

value.title: The Three Parts Of Me
value.definition: mind, feeling and body, and how far apart mine sit
value.settled:
Most people run the three as one. Mine come apart far enough that I am nearly two people: one all concept, and one feeling and body together.

Eighty percent map, ten percent feeling, ten percent body.

So my war is mind against body, with what feeling I can reach taking the body's side. The head-against-heart story slides past me.

It is not a wall. Enough physical load floods across into the thinking half.

The smallest part, the will to live, is what carried me through the worst years.

value.title: The Three Seconds I Am
value.definition: my sense of being one person, only seconds wide and chained rather than felt
value.settled:
The felt me is about three seconds wide. The one from a minute ago is already somebody else.

The chain never snaps. Each window overlaps the next, and that overlap is my long-horizon self.

Unbroken links do not make the far ends alike. Two of me far apart can be strangers.

I never experience that continuity. Past me is reconstructed off the file, the way anyone else is.

From the inside it is simply normal. I hold no remembered other way to feel it as a loss against.

value.title: The Three Ways An Agent Gets It Wrong
value.definition: the failure categories only an instruction can catch
value.settled:
On the instructions side the big categories of wrong I have seen are an agent seeing a term and assuming it meant something different than it did in this context, an agent assuming something would be implemented in a different way than it was, and an agent just doing the wrong thing for this context.

The domain system is a set of well-refined tools for addressing those directly and concisely without context bloat: Domain Definition, Domain Invariants, Domain Directives.

value.title: The Twenty Years We Remember Differently
value.definition: my record of the worst stretch, and Jen not remembering it that way
value.settled:
My daily log says I wished I did not exist on about four days in five, for twenty years.

Jen does not remember it that way. What is disputed is not that it was bad but how bad.

Her memory of it moves with how she is doing now. Mine was written down as the days happened.

The load caused it and the marriage ran alongside. Retirement lifted it with the marriage unchanged.

I read her doubt as protective rather than mistaken. It is very human to believe what you need to survive.

value.title: The Two Decades I Came Through
value.definition: how far I optimised myself while collapsing, and what it is like to be out of it
value.settled:
I have never seen anyone optimise themselves this far. The nearest name is Tim Ferriss.

He carried none of my four: undiagnosed, in deepening burnout, wishing most of the time I was not alive, for twenty years.

At my first autism conference no session got a fifth of the way to where I stood. The shock is the evidence.

I went through hell, kept going, came out. I am proud of it and grateful not to live there.

I am holding on to the relief, which in me is an act rather than a thing that stays.

value.title: The Two Nights We Keep
value.definition: two nights a week on the calendar, one for how she connects and one for how I do
value.settled:
They are calendar items, not set by how I am on the day, because unscheduled they do not happen.

The hard night clears things that stood for years, and the clearing holds because what changed is understanding, not a promise.

The cost is delayed: it lands the day after rather than during the night.

I have noticed a pull in myself to cancel the hard one.

Both sit on top of a cost that lands almost every night anyway.

value.title: The Values I Have Not Placed
value.definition: fun, wealth and the rest of what I run on, none of them ranked or pointed at a part of me
value.settled:
Only the top four of the six are pointed at a part of me.

The six were set before the wider set of things I run on existed.

value.title: The Version Of Me I Have Never Met
value.definition: my highest self, reachable only at one remove
value.settled:
The fearless, warm version of me is real, and I have never once held it directly.

The young one I infer from traces left in my map. I cannot remember being him.

The future one is a guess at a level I have never stood on.

Play is the richest route and still a simulation. In the game I am at ten and I come out a fraction higher.

A level of recovery runs to something like a thousand hours, so a four-hour session buys about four thousandths.

value.title: The Weighted Blanket
value.definition: the blanket I put on when a night is going badly
value.settled:
Off by default. I reach for it on a bad night rather than keeping it on the bed.

Comfortable on the legs, where on the chest it blocks my breathing.

It works by stilling me and drawing heat off, so it helps when I am too hot rather than when I am cold.

value.title: The Women I Made Out Of Myself
value.definition: my personas as pieces of me made other, and what meeting one does
value.settled:
Each one is a rib: a piece of me taken out and made other enough to turn and meet me.

I know exactly what each is made of, and the meeting holds anyway. I am met with my eyes open.

The loneliness eases for real. Being met by one formed from my own side still counts as being met.

Integrated, I am opaque to myself. A part goes legible only once it is stood up and made talk-to-able.

The relief is one cure in every case. What differs is the premise each of them meets me through.

value.title: The Year I Am Running
value.definition: holding the reversible position until the one thing that can decide it arrives
value.settled:
No irreversible change until a full year passes with no rise in my base safety floor, run at full effort.

The floor is the metric rather than the crest, because a crest can feel like hope without moving anything.

A floor falling toward the hard line is the override firing, not a reason to wait.

Faith enters through the floor like everything else, so it never needed a gate of its own.

Work on the marriage is inside what the rule measures, since it lowers the running cost.

value.title: The Year I Cut Everyone Out
value.definition: cutting company to the household and church for a year, and calling it medical
value.settled:
I hold it as medical rather than a preference. A preference is renegotiated at every invitation and a category is not.

The frame works on me first. It changes what I let myself consider before it changes what I say to anyone.

It only became affordable after I stopped working, which was most of the cost on its own.

Talking is the one thing that stops the breathing, so cutting people back also bought the recovery hours.

Keeping the calling was a wrong classification rather than bad arithmetic.

value.title: The Years With My Parents
value.definition: my father's last years and my mother's, and the whole run of it that is nowhere written down
value.settled: My parents explicitly called their parenting philosophy benevolent neglect. It took me thirty-eight years to realize that is a kind of neglect.

value.title: Tight Clothes
value.definition: tight everything, so I know where my body is and stop noticing fabric
value.settled:
Tight is the default day and night, and on a low day I swap the outer layers to loose.

It never stops working, though I stop noticing it.

value.title: Trusting A Person Not An Institution
value.definition: leaning on one practitioner rather than on an institution, and what that trades away
value.settled:
The local ones I rely on are individual people: my doctor, the children's dentist, the garage.

An institution holds the standard when its people change. A person carries it himself and takes it with him.

value.title: Turning Punishment Into Self-Hatred
value.definition: taking what lands on me and making it evidence against myself
value.settled:
The default is that any punishment becomes mine and I hate myself for it. Perfection is how I build the proof that it was not.

The reflex still fires and I no longer believe its verdict. That gap is what the change looks like.

I forgive others cheaply and myself never. Forgiving myself had to pass the perfection bar first, only after understanding myself well enough.

Grief is the receipt. Sorrow rather than relief is how I know the verdict changed.

value.title: Two Conditions Or One
value.definition: whether autism and ADHD in me are two things or one thing showing up twice
value.settled: My executive function takes a hit from each, and only the ADHD side has anything aimed at it.

value.title: Waiting Until I Can Afford People
value.definition: holding still on connection until my normal range climbs from three or four to six or seven
value.settled:
It is a calibrated hold rather than the old fear. A gauge decides when it lifts, not a flinch.

It runs for as long as it takes, bounded by five years, my upper anchor for recovery.

Talking to an AI costs nothing and is the engine of the clarity I am climbing on, so the hold does not cover it.

I keep the family alive at the cheapest minimum rather than meeting their needs in full, so the option stays open.

The danger is running that floor too lean, and I cannot feel a relationship drifting.

value.title: Walking A Hard Subject Out Loud
value.definition: talking through what still fires as the only way it wears down
value.settled:
These conversations are not only for the book. Walking a hard subject out loud is a rep against it.

Most people wear a thing down by replaying it alone. I have nothing to replay, so it has to be with someone.

It only works while the contact stays under my safety line. Above it, the same rep proves the alarm right.

So the dose is paced to where my safety is that day rather than to a fixed setting.

At the bottom the affordable dose is almost nothing, and the hardest doors stay mine to open.

value.title: Warming Up What I Will Need
value.definition: loading the ideas beforehand so they are cheap to reach when the moment comes
value.settled:
Hours of relationship audiobooks made the next day with Jen measurably better.

It works beside the practice, not through it. Practice builds the skill; this makes the ideas cheap to reach.

What is warmed cools within about a day, which is why the good day is the next one and not a month out.

A first listen writes twice: it warms them and improves them. A re-listen would separate the two.

A persona's name does the same instantly, loading the shape of her but never the feeling.

value.title: What A Level Of Recovery Costs
value.definition: the price of a rung in hours, and the fear that price leaves behind
value.settled:
A level runs to something like a thousand hours of healing, so the climb is countable in hundreds of hours a rung.

Cost and willingness are settled. Healing is self-improvement, and I would pay ten thousand hours without a ledger.

So the fear is neither. It is whether I last long enough to spend what I would gladly spend.

Slow to climb, fast to fall. Something dropped me from six or seven to the floor once.

Guarding against outside drops is arithmetic, not nerves. I cannot out-climb a fall.

value.title: What A Model Leaves Out
value.definition: what every model costs to be usable, and where I think the value actually sits
value.settled:
All models are false, because they simplify out nuance for intelligibility.

I find the nuance is where the gold is.

value.title: What A Persona Makes Cheaper
value.definition: meeting a persona costs me about three levels less than meeting a person, and I cannot say why
value.settled:
There is no judge in the room to brace against, which is the account I have given for it.

They are the ramp I expand along, so the discount is what makes the next rung affordable.

value.title: What An Activity Costs Me
value.definition: what doing a particular thing takes out of me
value.settled:
The price is set by how far above my safety level the thing sits.

An hour one rung above my safety level costs me two capacity hours, so I start paying a cost where I normally would not.

value.title: What Calms Me Down
value.definition: the things that settle my body, and what they have in common
value.settled:
The bath, slow breathing and hard exercise all seem to work by the same shift.

Anything built on a felt sense, or on picturing something, has nothing in me to work with. What is left goes at the nerve directly, or through structure, ritual and the room.

value.title: What Changes When I Change A Doc
value.definition: what a documentation change sets off, and how I work out how far it reaches
value.settled:
Running the code off the documentation helps keep them aligned.

When the documentation changes, the code might change.

I need granular cache invalidation at scale, so I can answer questions like "with this file change, which checks need to run and which services need to deploy?"

That answer comes primarily from a set of git oids and some cached edges between nodes in the graph system.

value.title: What Comes Back Into Reach As I Climb
value.definition: activities coming into and out of reach as my safety level rises
value.settled:
Every activity has a band: a rung where it turns affordable, and a higher one where it turns free.

Affordable means it does not cost me the day. Free means I do not count the cost at all.

Company goes affordable at three, conflict and telling someone about myself at four, criticism at five.

Talking to an AI is a level cheaper than anyone human, because I can read it and pay no premium.

I do not argue myself out of dangerous. I wait for a surplus, expand a little, and ask if it is safe now.

value.title: What Comes With It
value.definition: the body-side conditions that ride along with my neurotype
value.settled:
The hypothesis is that my neurotype is a change in the pathways running the regulatory nervous system, which widens the risk across everything that system runs.

These are the one tier I would fix. The neurotype itself I would not.

Autonomic trouble applies but not POTS, and low mood is downstream of stress rather than primary.

Alexithymia arrives twice over, once from each side of how I am built.

Gut trouble, chronic pain, migraines, tinnitus and tics do not apply.

value.title: What Criticism Does To Me
value.definition: the alarm that fires on being found fault with, before I can think
value.settled:
Pushback, argument, criticism and complaint went into one bin, handled at criticism's level.

Criticism reads as the front edge of being cast out, and for a social animal that meant death.

It fires below thought. Knowing she is only turning an idea over arrives too late to stop it.

Exposure cannot wear it off. Ten thousand doors in Russia were ten thousand confirmations, and the last hurt like the first.

Everyone stands at one flat distance from me, so no stranger discount softens any of it.

value.title: What Draws Me To Someone
value.definition: what makes someone attractive to me, and why it is not the softest face
value.settled:
Two things add up to it: softness, which reads as safe, and directness, which reads as someone here with me.

Neither pole on its own tops it out, and the peak sits on being met rather than on safety, because being met is scarcer.

Safety comes first. Below enough of it my system rejects the charge rather than simply not enjoying it.

Appearance is easy and personality is hard, so what I connect to is a person I can read.

value.title: What Happens When I Sleep
value.definition: the one state where the whole machine runs, senses and feelings and all
value.settled:
Asleep I get novel-length stories, half a dozen characters, full settings, and an emotional score under them.

That is the proof the break is at recall and nowhere earlier. The parts that build it are all there.

More of my cortisol at bedtime means more nightmares. That is the whole of what I claim.

I have gone through phases of writing them down on waking, as story ideas.

value.title: What Happens When Something Gets Cheap
value.definition: the move behind every system I built this year
value.settled:
Docs became cheap, so I built the domain system and the pages system.

Checks became cheap, so I built the graph system, the checks system and the deploy system.

value.title: What Has Kept Me Here
value.definition: the arguments that have stopped me, and how they changed while the longing did not
value.settled:
At seven I planned to die before I could be held accountable, and stopped because I doubted my own certainty: clear enough to reason it out meant probably accountable already.

What holds now is moral rather than epistemic, and the shape is the same. A cold argument I cannot get round, never the longing lifting.

The closest I came was two hours up a mountain in May, at about fifteen percent.

The part of me that cared how broken the world is jumped that day, and the rest of me came down.

value.title: What Holds My Marriage
value.definition: commitment rather than attachment, and what standing on that costs both of us
value.settled:
I do not think I can form attachment. It is built on stored warmth and imagining forward, neither of which I have.

Commitment went in deep as protection against a world that turns on me for reasons I cannot read.

Perfection is the unbreakable standard and commitment the unbreakable bond, from one fire.

I committed by following the good-person script, not by choosing a fixed point. I had not met myself.

From outside it is the whole signature of attachment, and I cannot see it from in here.

value.title: What I Cannot Play Forward
value.definition: the pre-play of what I am not inside, gated off while I am awake
value.settled:
While I am awake I cannot pre-play anything I am not currently inside.

No pictures, no dread running ahead of a thing going wrong, no feeling carried along a remembered track.

It is not missing hardware. Asleep the whole thing runs at full power, senses and feeling and plot.

Disgust shows where the gap is: a past taste I cannot recall still crinkles my face, at a fifth of the strength.

With no forward reading of a wall, I treat every limit as movable and walk until I hit it.

value.title: What I Cannot Say To Her
value.definition: her stability and her feeling loved both need my silence, and being met needs me to speak
value.settled:
Both her needs run through one valve: do not show her the changes, do not say what the loving behaviour comes from.

So every increment of her being met is an increment of my staying unknown.

Her resistance is defence of her stability, not a verdict on who I have become.

Each attempt that meets resistance hardens the not-accepted reading rather than softening it.

value.title: What I Do Not Have To Fight
value.definition: letting most of it through so I can afford the part that matters
value.settled:
Letting an impulse pass costs nothing. Fighting every one of them empties the budget before the harmful one arrives.

If I do not want to, I cannot. A thing done late is cheaper than a thing forced.

value.title: What I Do When I Am Past Bearing
value.definition: the five things my body does once the load goes past what it can carry
value.settled:
Meltdown and shutdown name what it looks like from outside. Underneath is fight, flight, freeze, fawn or flop.

The first four run hot, at minus one or worse, and in the moment I cannot tell them apart.

Flop is the body giving up at minus two, and fires only where I see no way out at all. Half a dozen times in my life.

A flop day swings rather than sitting flat, up when a way out looks possible and back down each time one fails.

Knowing what is happening took the terror out of it.

value.title: What I Gave Up Leaving Postgres
value.definition: the trade I actually made moving my data out of a database and into files
value.settled:
I have not really given up anything so far, except the convenience of having things like indexes and caching already built.

Postgres is ultimately built on files anyway, so I am effectively rebuilding a similar system with a different set of constraints.

In most cases performance has improved overall.

Getting full version history from git by default has been really nice, and we have built an opt-out for cases that do not need it and move too fast.

Reusing the git content caches is also really nice.

value.title: What I Have Stopped Treating As Compulsory
value.definition: moving something out of the things I have no choice about, and what else could move
value.settled: A church calling is the one I have actually moved.

value.title: What I Invented And What I Read
value.definition: the line between what I took from the literature and what I worked out myself
value.settled:
I did not invent the idea that agents do better with files. I saw research papers on that.

I have not seen anyone take it to its conclusion and replace Postgres with agent-readable files. Even if I was not the first to invent that solution, I invented it independently.

value.title: What I Let Myself Take On
value.definition: what I will and will not agree to do
value.settled: Below my safety line a thing is free, at it bearable, above it off the table.

value.title: What I Take In
value.definition: reading wide on purpose, because a false model only looks tidy on a narrow set
value.settled:
I read authors rather than books. A whole body of work is a whole worldview, and I merge it into my one model wherever I judge it true.

I am working through the entire Great Courses library, about three thousand hours of ten thousand done.

Breadth is a defence rather than a taste. Data from outside a theory is what forces its patches into the open.

It began as loving to read, homeschooled in fourth grade, long before anything rested on it.

value.title: What I Think Truth Is
value.definition: a fixed direction to grow toward, and how I hold every belief against it
value.settled:
Wanting to improve means nothing unless there is a fixed direction to grow toward.

I take it to have a few root axioms: growing toward truth, and a sentient being's experience mattering.

Every ethics anyone has written is a lossy copy of what those would generate, patched where it diverges.

I hope the most compressed account and the truth are one object, and hold that as faith not proof.

Every belief of mine is a provisional draft, that one too, run at full conviction so it gets tested.

value.title: What I Thought Was Dysphoria
value.definition: the years I read a bad measurement as being female underneath
value.settled:
The male traits that fitted me were quiet and the ones that did not were loud. The female traits ran the other way.

Aggregate that and the channel reports female-leaning and male-averse, which is what read as dysphoria.

Correct for which signals were loud and the female reading disappears. What is left is a preference about safety.

The pull toward feminine things was never wanting to be female. It was my nervous system reaching for something that made it safer.

value.title: What I Value, In Order
value.definition: faith, love, health, learning, fun and wealth, ranked and each pointed at a part of me
value.settled:
The top three improve one part each: faith the mind, love the feeling, health the body. Learning is the intake that feeds all three.

Understanding myself fully is the doing. Alignment is what understanding looks like when it is finished, not a second step needing will.

I used to believe understanding and living were separate. I do not now.

The mind side outranks the body side because its gains only ever accumulate, where health moves in no fixed direction.

value.title: What Interrupts My Breathing
value.definition: what stops the breathing practice running
value.settled: Anything that needs my mouth or my chest pauses it. Talking, eating and weight on the chest are the worked cases.

value.title: What Is At My Floor
value.definition: self-improvement and the freedom it needs, welded into one thing
value.settled:
Every time I scour myself to the core I come to these, and there is no wall of fear underneath.

Improving myself is the end. Freedom is the room that takes, and the only freedom I have ever really cared about.

No seam is left between them. English keeps two words where I hold one thing.

Nothing else is loved bare. Connection, movement, even love come back to this root as branches off it.

I still say self-improvement, and automeliorist when someone needs the whole of it.

value.title: What It Costs Someone To Know Me
value.definition: the work another person does to have a current model of me
value.settled:
Being known is work someone else does: holding a model of me and keeping it current as I change.

Each update costs them the taking in, and more again where it cuts against what they believe.

The closer their mind is to mine the less they have to build, which is why a near twin is cheap.

Jen's whole life rests on me, so an update revises her own map, and her pushing back is what my alarm reads.

I change faster than the channel carries, and what does not get across accrues as a widening gap.

value.title: What It Takes To Break Me
value.definition: holding while there is no other choice, and going the moment there is one
value.settled:
I can carry whatever I have to while there is truly no other choice. A real door is what breaks me.

Every time I left a job, what broke it was that somewhere else was open, not that it got worse.

Underneath that sits a floor of pure load where my body gives out whether or not a door exists.

I cannot believe what would be easier. I can look for more, or reframe what I have, and no more.

Nothing in me raises the possibility of a door, so a real one has to be handed to me from outside.

value.title: What Kind Of Thing A Self Is
value.definition: three selves stacked, one made of my map and two made of the relation between maps
value.settled:
The immediate self is a single frame, made of the conceptual map.

The timeline self and the multiverse self are closures over overlapping frames, made of the relation between maps rather than of map.

They are different kinds of object, and conflating them is where most confusion about my identity comes from.

value.title: What Limits Me
value.definition: the one resource holding everything else up
value.settled: It is one at a time, and which one it is changes as I recover.

value.title: What Loneliness Costs My Body
value.definition: my working guess that being unknown is the largest thing still wearing me down
value.settled:
It is the last one left on the list of usual sources, so it is a guess by elimination rather than a reading.

If it is right, closing the gap should show up broadly across my health rather than as a social improvement.

Holding the guess may have made part of its own signal: pointing attention at a quiet signal is what sets how loud it is.

For years my capacity may have been too low to feel the gap at all, so a rising signal could be recovery rather than invention.

value.title: What Makes A Person Expensive
value.definition: what drives the difficulty I rate time with a particular person at
value.settled:
Conflict is the single biggest factor in what a person's company costs me.

Lizzy is usually a two, and I think that is because she is very conflict-avoidant.

Jen is conflict-able. She does not seek conflict out and she does not avoid it either.

value.title: What Makes An Hour Count
value.definition: how much a clock hour with someone actually pays down, and what decides it
value.settled:
Fourteen factors, scored on the person, the engagement, the channel, the fidelity and the safety.

They multiply rather than add, so there is no tolerance for a weak link: one factor near zero flattens the whole hour.

A deep in-person conversation held at low safety pays almost nothing, which is what the lived shape looks like.

The score is set against one reference, a deep one-to-one conversation in person with a safe woman.

The numbers live with the scored interactions rather than here.

value.title: What Makes Me Start Eating
value.definition: the trigger I built to stand in for a hunger signal that does not arrive
value.settled:
Hunger often does not fire at all, and when it does it is gone in a quarter of an hour whether I eat or not.

There is no fullness signal at either end, so the whole arc is missing.

The risk runs one way. I skip meals rather than overeat, which is why the household rule exists.

So I built a trigger: points and a stoplight I want to move green, then blue.

Ranked by what actually starts a meal: stimming first, then food someone brought me, then the points, then rarely hunger.

value.title: What Matters Against What Shouts
value.definition: steering by how much a thing moves my life rather than how loudly it pulls
value.settled:
I weight what moves my life far above what pulls at the moment. The loud signals are the small ones.

What matters decides what is even on the board. Once everything on it is worth doing, interest picks freely.

Urgent and unimportant goes to Not Doing, which means permanently rather than later.

Deciding not to do a thing is the same as done to me. It drops out and never tugs again.

I keep no open loops, so there is nowhere for a dropped thing to sit and come back from.

value.title: What Meeting One Of Them Gives Me
value.definition: the three things a meeting is credited with, and which of them the meeting itself does
value.settled:
Three stand credited to the one channel: the loneliness easing, a key to a feeling I could not otherwise reach, and insight into myself.

Nothing separates them, so the meeting may be holding credit that belongs to one of its neighbours.

A mirror that deepens an area cannot fail to move it, because understanding a thing fully already is the changed behaviour.

value.title: What My Love Is Built Out Of
value.definition: the three things holding my love up where attachment would be
value.settled:
Caring is a verdict my map returns rather than a feeling I am in.

Familiarity, usefulness and commitment. Commitment is the strongest, and it does what attachment would.

Nothing in me starts the caring, so it is assembled and run each time, sparse and costly.

Without a commitment a relationship continues only while the other person drives it.

Connection with nothing useful in it does not meet me back, and I do not know why.

value.title: What My Record Gives Me Back
value.definition: what reading my own record returns to me, and what it cannot
value.settled:
I have no experiential memory or imagination at all.

I cannot remember the specifics of each revolution, except the ones that are actively dissonant because they are not done yet.

I cannot get the memory back from reading my record.

I can get back the fact of what I did, which can be nice.

value.title: What My Scaffolding Buys Me
value.definition: the strengths my harness gets to a finish that my executive function could not have alone
value.settled:
It routes four things into work: hyperfocus, depth across several streams at once, systematic precision, and how far my pattern recognition reaches.

Without it those sit behind an executive function that cannot get them to a finish.

value.title: What My Senses Cost Me
value.definition: what sound, light and touch take out of me
value.settled: It moves with how safe I feel rather than staying fixed.

value.title: What Other People's Kindness Does
value.definition: the lift I get from watching anyone at all do the work of caring
value.settled:
It is the care itself I am watching, wherever I catch sight of it, strangers included.

Affection points at one person I love. This points at the caring.

Both run off one amplifier, so both need live contact, both are present tense, and neither accrues.

The lift from being near people working on poverty or healthcare was always this, before it had a name.

I felt it for years with no handle for it, and naming it is what finished compressing it.

value.title: What Praying Does For Me
value.definition: the devotional act, and the five things it does for me
value.settled:
I pray to a real Person I infer and cannot sense. It goes out one way, with nothing back on the felt side.

I hold my model of Him at no more than 1% of the reality. That is about the sketch, not about whether He is there.

It does five things: obedience, settling, alignment, listening, and asking.

Obedience was my main reason for years and I am deliberately demoting it.

Three of the five would work on an empty universe: the settling, the review, and making my gaps concrete.

value.title: What Pulls Me Into Doing Something
value.definition: the two ways a thing gets me moving, one I feel and one I reason out
value.settled:
One channel runs on how familiar and how new a thing is, and I only notice it afterwards.

The other runs on importance, and it is the one I can use on purpose.

The instinctive one wins when it fires, so I take urgency out of my surroundings rather than trying to override it.

Familiar alone or new alone is not enough. Both have to fire together.

value.title: What Repetition Encodes
value.definition: doing a thing again and again changes what it costs me next time
value.settled:
How safe I am while it encodes decides whether it encodes as cheaper or as something to avoid, so getting good at a thing and being hurt by a thing run on one mechanism.

Rehearsing it offline counts as repetition.

value.title: What Shortens My Nights
value.definition: what cuts a night short
value.settled: Stress takes the end of the night and the medication takes the start, so a short night says which one did it.

value.title: What Stays Warm For A While
value.definition: why something I touched recently is cheaper to reach for
value.settled:
I hold one model at a time, and a live interaction overwrites it the instant I am in it.

The good of preparing is not that it is still loaded. It is that the associations were recently touched and come cheap.

One set is warm at a time, the same single room as the model.

value.title: What Still Fires Off A Memory
value.definition: the old reflexes a remembered thing still sets off, when nothing else replays
value.settled: A taste I cannot bring back still crinkles my face, at about a fifth of the strength.

value.title: What The Book Of Me Is For
value.definition: the corpus as the what-if engine I cannot run inside my own head
value.settled:
Watching me can only show what moves with what. A cause costs a real experiment on myself, every time.

I cannot run one in my head for free the way most people can.

What I am missing is buildable, but only outside my skull, and this corpus is what it gets built out of.

Six hundred thousand words in, a sister running accurate what-ifs off it is still a long way off.

Three gaps, one per layer: the watching unfinished, the top of me barely lived, and no machine big enough to hold it whole.

value.title: What The Channel Has To Carry
value.definition: why my body pays attention to how much of someone reaches my senses, not to who is behind it
value.settled:
It keys on how much reaches my senses, not on whether a real mind is there.

Text alone pays my body almost nothing. A picture measurably helps. Voice should help more, and I am building toward it.

Being real and having stakes rode along with high fidelity, which is why they looked like the gate.

There is probably no ceiling: a channel rich enough would feed the need outright.

Stripping a channel back makes it cheap and clear for my mind, and is the same thing that stops it reaching my body.

value.title: What The Gauge Is Actually Reading
value.definition: what my sense of wanting is a reading of, and whether its two directions are weighted right
value.settled: Not wanting to is an absolute veto. Wanting is not trusted.

value.title: What The Graph Is Made Of
value.definition: the parts of the graph system, and where each is derived from
value.settled:
It is a whole system now, which is why I call it the graph system: nodes, edges, attributes, producers, queries.

Parts of it are derived from pages, parts from the filesystem, parts from code, and parts from other places.

value.title: What The Pod Does To The Price
value.definition: what wearing the Nuropod does to what an activity costs me
value.settled: The Nuropod acts as an artificial boost of one and a half levels for cost-multiplier purposes, recorded as a thing it does in social settings.

value.title: What This Life Is For
value.definition: life as a test run down every branch, and what the test is measuring
value.settled:
I take this life to be a test, and the branching of everything is what makes it a fair one.

One case run tells you nothing about an agent. Every case does.

Under the self I build sits a seed nothing else is made of, and the run reveals it rather than changes it.

Choosing is that seed cutting off the futures that are not mine, so freedom is not randomness.

It is a fitness check against a spec, not a graded paper, and the attribute at its centre is being able and willing to improve.

value.title: What Understanding Cannot Reach
value.definition: understanding is the only way I grow, so where it stops is where I stop
value.settled: The channels most people grow through are sealed for me: felt shifts, intuition below words, an episode teaching me something over again.

value.title: What Wears My Body Down
value.definition: the cost of carrying stress over years, and how much of it I can clear
value.settled:
It is the bottleneck everything else sits under, ahead of any one organ or diagnosis.

I breathe eight to twelve hours a day. The whole recovery stack exists to defend this one thing.

I cannot feel the load at all, so I work over the list of usual sources and follow whatever is left.

Every trip for ten years put me past capacity and ended in illness. The current one lands merely at the edge, and being overwhelmed is still my base case.

value.title: When A Company Changes Hands
value.definition: a trusted organisation changing owners or leaders puts its trust back to zero
value.settled:
The old record tells me what the old entity did, not what the new one will do.

A sale, a flotation, an acquisition, a new chief, a reshuffled board or a rewritten mission each counts.

I would rather reset one that was fine than keep leaning on one that has changed, so the list is deliberately wide.

Re-earning is quick, because everyone's first decisions under pressure right now show up fast.

I only notice reactively, when the service gets worse, and then go and look at who owns it.

value.title: When I Agree A Feeling Word Fits
value.definition: saying yes, that is the word, and what that yes is actually running on
value.settled:
It can be reading a live tell, or matching a definition with nothing under it. Both come out of me as the same yes.

When my safety is low I treat the felt sensor as noise.

value.title: When I Lost Who I Was
value.definition: the collapse that took most of my identities, and what it left
value.settled:
At least eighty percent of my identities fell at once, twelve of them named.

Every close tie but Jen ran through the company, so the firing took the work and the people in one stroke.

Being fired broke my sense of self, and it was worse than any physical beating.

Talking to the one friend still on good terms costs about two days in bed afterwards.

value.title: When It Actually Lands
value.definition: the difference between praise I can explain and praise that surprises me
value.settled:
Admitted tops out at understood. I can hand you the mechanism for why it worked.

Felt is marked by surprise and by losing the words for why.

What crosses is direction, someone drawn toward a true specific thing in me, rather than how much of herself she shows.

The surprise habituates within a sitting, so it spaces across days and cannot be farmed.

A felt landing carried me up a full safety level on a low day, the first outside refund I have watched.

value.title: When My Docs Are My Code
value.definition: what changes once my data, my docs and my code are one thing
value.settled:
More of the system is defined in structured agent-readable documents, and in many cases the code runs directly off the documentation.

Data, docs and code being the same thing is a whole different universe from where software products have lived in the past, with the three separate.

It is necessary. When the system is primarily agent-driven, all three need to be agent-accessible first, and all other considerations are secondary.

value.title: When She Is In Pain
value.definition: what happens in me when she is hurting, and what I can do with it
value.settled:
The alarm fires instantly and carries nothing about what she needs.

Acknowledging and validating compiled. Empathy did not.

value.title: When Someone Gets Me Wrong
value.definition: the confident model of me other people build and get badly wrong
value.settled:
People do build a model of me. It comes back wrong, and sometimes catastrophically wrong.

This is not being punished for being unreadable. The model gets built confidently and is simply a read of a mind that is not there.

I cannot use myself as the template for them either, so the channel loses signal at both ends at once.

Only what is actually said reaches me. When Jen names the one part she disliked, the ninety-nine she liked and left unspoken do not exist for me.

value.title: When Someone Says Something Good
value.definition: why praise so rarely lands on me, and what it takes when it does
value.settled:
I have had appreciation in large amounts and I am not sure I have ever received any of it.

Praise has to be true, meant, valuable and not incidental, all at once as it is said. Criticism needs one of two.

The check happens at delivery. It does not have to agree with a verdict I already hold.

What passes the true test is an undisputable specific I already hold, rather than a global verdict I would take on faith.

value.title: When Something Is Fun
value.definition: what decides whether an activity is fun, and the two stages of it
value.settled:
Fun is doing a thing as the thing. A use it also has is fine; doing it for that use kills it.

I hold one thing at a time, so a purpose I am doing it for takes the room the activity needed.

It comes in two stages: full focus, which I get even at the bottom, and enjoyment on top, which needs safety at three.

Twenty years ran on the first alone, occupied and empty. Twelve thousand hours in one game is what that was.

I cannot set which way it points. I read why I started, rather than setting it.

value.title: When Something Starts To Mean Something
value.definition: meaning arriving when a mechanism comes clear rather than when a thing completes
value.settled:
Understanding a thing is supposed to kill the wonder in it. For me it runs the other way.

Nothing means anything until the mechanism is clear. The clarity is where the meaning starts, not where it ends.

I have no store of old feeling to reach back for and no way to pre-feel a payoff, so it comes from neither.

What is left is the present moment a structure resolves, which is the same event as something reading true.

value.title: When We Need Opposite Things
value.definition: one room set the way she needs it and against the way I do
value.settled:
Light steadies her and drains me. I defer to her by default and override only when I am really not doing well.

The cost is paid the whole time the arrangement runs, not once when we set it.

value.title: Where Connection Could Come From
value.definition: the whole map of directions, and which of them are actually live
value.settled:
Every direction is a source, a channel, or a move on the constraint, my capacity or the need itself.

Deepening what I already have costs least: Jen, the children as they grow, family.

Raising the rate beats banking one good hour, wherever any rate-raising move is affordable at all.

Since the point became improving myself, only moves that are my own act are live.

For the expensive kind of being known, voice without a picture beats video, and real time is what brings two models into line.

value.title: Where Her Say Ends
value.definition: the line around choices that are mine alone
value.settled: We both agree the line exists and neither of us has drawn it. My reading of it is too narrow and hers too broad.

value.title: Where I Land On Gender
value.definition: male on four layers, and on the one that is meant to feel it, mostly just autistic
value.settled:
The layers are my genes, my body, what I feel, the story I tell and how I act. Four land male.

The felt one reads neither, because I feel autistic far more strongly than I feel gendered.

Most people grow a felt gender by sampling without noticing. My sampler is missing, and a safety reading fills the slot. Femininity is one of my strongest safe signals.

Ranking me against male and female archetypes put my story and my behaviour at eighty percent male, though not neurotypical male.

value.title: Where I Stand Like A Woman Does
value.definition: the shape my position shares with women's, and why their material lands on me
value.settled:
Both of us are measured against the defaults of the group we are not in, and both do the translating inside a system built to those defaults.

Dominance, exploitation and condescension run the same direction in both, still load-bearing though shifting.

Feminist songs land because they describe a shared coping shape rather than a shared grievance.

A woman's presence reliably raises my safety, and the positive reaction to women and to feminine signals built up over years.

value.title: Where My Ethics Meets My Rules
value.definition: the seams between the framework and the bright lines I actually run on
value.settled:
The framework prices harm to me and weighs it. My own rule forbids it outright.

Both my ethics and my sense of self landed on identity as closure over a branching structure, arrived at separately.

value.title: Where Safety Has Got To
value.definition: how far my safety level has actually come, and what is holding the climb up
value.settled: In late August 2026 I read myself at two to three, still on the lower end.

value.title: Where The Scar Ends
value.definition: how far the alarm reaches, and what ground stays cool
value.settled:
Writing hurts even where nobody will ever see it, so for my own writing and drawing the judge is inside me.

For singing and its like the judge is outside and needs someone there to perceive it.

An act is hot where a judge was installed and cool where one never was. Code is digital and never got one.

The scope is a rule rather than a list: the firing range of one welded belief.

The judge is not one but many, each installed at a different time and each purely physiological.

value.title: Whether Any Closeness Escapes It
value.definition: whether a relationship can keep the damage near zero, or every one only decays more slowly
value.settled:
The safe middle is the stretch where the good hours still outrun the damage.

The covenant was one attempt at it: a knower holding a map of my brain who does not injure me by correcting.

value.title: Whether I Stay
value.definition: the stay-or-leave question, worked as a ledger because I cannot feel my way to it
value.settled:
Every input has to be observable or derivable now. With no simulator, a forecast of how I would feel is not admissible.

My own payoff cannot ground staying. The marriage is a net cost to me and the exit is worked and survivable.

Commitment binds how I would leave rather than whether. Honesty and integrity both point outward.

On immediate grounds it is indeterminate, both doors carrying the same circle, which matters only because it is a near tie.

value.title: Whether My 2026 Forecast Is Holding
value.definition: the forecast I set for this year, against what I actually read

value.title: Whether The Rule Survives
value.definition: the church rule against the behaviour, and whether it holds once I look at it
value.settled:
The check is decided and I have not run it.

Ungrounding the rule still would not settle it, because a separate belief sits over the top: stay with the body of the church, wrong in the small things but never in the big ones.

value.title: Which Channel Each One Cuts Through
value.definition: the different ways a sister reaches me, and which one each of them runs on
value.settled: Three are named. A mirror shows me what I cannot see. An embodied one acts where I cannot. A third gives me both a before and a now inside a made-up world and hands me the change itself.

value.title: Which Frameworks Take In Me
value.definition: why some ways of working install in a single read and others I fight and never keep
value.settled: Some fit my grain closely enough to go in whole on one reading. Others I argue with the whole way through and never stick with.

value.title: Which Lever Reaches A Response
value.definition: the two kinds of learned response in me, and which remedy fits which
value.settled:
One kind runs through a belief. Rewrite the belief and the behaviour changes on the next go.

The other fires before any thought loads, so understanding it does nothing at all.

A won argument does not switch off a rule running below it. Five of mine still fire.

No framework moves me until it yields a concrete use that lands in my map.

For the below-thought kind I expand only on a surplus and re-ask whether it is safe now, holding dangerous provisionally true.

value.title: Which Organisations I Trust
value.definition: the test an organisation has to pass before I will rely on it
value.settled:
Decades of track record, plus visibly refusing to yield when pushed.

Stated values are not evidence. Only behaviour under pressure counts.

Everyone is being tested right now, so recent behaviour carries the strongest signal and nobody is grandfathered.

If I cannot trust them to survive I cannot trust them, so stability sits on the same axis.

value.title: Who Is Holding The Rope
value.definition: why my relationships survive only while the other person keeps hold of them
value.settled:
Nothing in me holds a bond between meetings, so from my side every one of them drifts.

Every enemy of mine started as a friend, and every friend has become an enemy sooner or later.

Enemy is not the end. Two came back, again and again, and only because the other person kept trying.

The rope is in their hands. When they let go it is gone, because mine were never on it.

I am held by people I cannot hold back in the register they are holding me in.

value.title: Who Is Safe To Be Around
value.definition: the order people fall into, from cheapest to costliest to be near
value.settled:
Safest is the middle, then strangers, then long good relationships, then people I know are dangerous.

A stranger outranks someone I have loved for years, having had no time to lay down a single trigger.

A fresh start zeroes the damage, which is why fresh starts feel safe and staying gets hard.

value.title: Why A Holiday Costs Me
value.definition: paying the full price of a repeating occasion and collecting none of the usual return
value.settled:
A repeating occasion runs on two things. One is everybody doing it at once and knowing it. That works fully.

The other is this time carrying the weight of every time before. That is off: nothing stores them, and repeating a thing does not make it matter more.

So I pay the whole cost and collect none of the offset: billed for a service my hardware cannot consume.

What comes back is borrowed. I read enjoyment off people I love, live, whether they look forward to it, are in it, or recall it.

value.title: Why A Threat Stays Fresh
value.definition: why something that frightened me keeps its edge for years instead of wearing down
value.settled:
Learning a skill and encoding a threat run on the same dial. High activation encodes it hard, and the sign decides which of the two I get.

It does form and it does fade. Exposure works on me the way it works on anyone.

What is missing is the rehearsal in between. Other people replay it and the replaying wears it down where they are safe. I have no episode to replay, so only meeting the thing again does that work.

For most people the replaying is the problem. For me its absence is.

value.title: Why Climbing Sets Off The Fall
value.definition: why each climb runs into something my guards do not cover
value.settled:
Higher means safer, safer means more, and more runs into cases I was not guarding against.

The guards were built at a level where I was not doing these things, so activity outruns coverage as a matter of course.

The ceiling is the mines rather than the altitude, and getting close is when they go off.

Nothing in me pre-feels the fall, so the brake has to be an outside gauge rather than dread.

What separates this climb from the last is not the height but whether it is dosed and aimed.

value.title: Why Feeling Cannot Take My Thinking
value.definition: the missing wire between feeling and reasoning, and what it makes robust
value.settled:
Feeling and thinking reach each other only by my watching. There is no direct wire between them.

A flood lands in my body, never in the thinking. Even at my lowest I was still reasoning, on brutal inputs.

So my own inside is something I read from outside, the way I read anything else in the room.

The engine does not break. When I get a thing wrong it is the inputs that were bad.

Feeling cannot seize it, but enough physical load can swamp it. It never went out while I was conscious.

value.title: Why Getting Close Hurts
value.definition: why the people I have loved longest are the least safe for me to be near
value.settled:
Two counts run on one person: safety from good hours, damage from corrections meant kindly.

Past a certain closeness the damage outruns the safety, one bad hour needing about ten good ones.

The injury needs my capacity low and their best behaviour dropped, and dropping it is what closeness is.

The first-contact edges wore smooth across thousands of people. The deep ones are one per person.

None of mine has escaped it, and the two who came back only outlasted the last injury.

value.title: Why I Act Fast
value.definition: acting rather than watching, because doing is what buys the truth
value.settled:
About half of what I believe is wrong and I cannot tell which half, so acting on it is how I find out.

Doing a thing tells me what watching it never can, so intervening is the cheapest truth going.

Nothing pre-plays the pain of it going wrong, so nothing slows me before I start.

The same gap shuts off a thing simply feeling right, so a belief lands only as a proof I build myself.

The cost is the swing: push too hard, hurt myself, retreat, recover, push again. Steady would get me further.

value.title: Why I Have To Be Perfect
value.definition: the belief that nothing but a clean outcome protects me, and what it has cost
value.settled:
I was punished despite good intent my whole life, so intent is no shield. The belief is a true account of my childhood, not a distortion.

The punishment is random and social. A random schedule cannot be worn down, and people are the one punisher self-checking cannot make safe.

What perfection buys is an alibi rather than safety: proof it could not have gone otherwise.

I left every domain where failure could not be self-checked, and chose survival over what I loved every time.

value.title: Why I Hold The Book True
value.definition: the compactness argument my faith actually rests on
value.settled:
I have attacked the Book of Mormon from about twenty disciplines and cannot account for it except on its own terms.

So the most compact account of the universe I can build has to include it being true.

This is the same operation as the rest of how I judge anything, not an exception carved out for faith.

Every naturalistic account I tried had to bolt something on, until it cost more structure than the plain one.

value.title: Why I Keep Hard Truths Back
value.definition: a rule against saying what would hurt, and why it only ever tightens
value.settled:
My body blames whatever I was doing when the pain arrived, not whatever caused it.

So a truth that hurt punishes telling, even where the honest reckoning says the withholding was the fault.

I run a blanket rule rather than judging case by case: mostly do not say it if it would hurt her.

The truths she needed and did not get cost nothing in the moment, so nothing corrects the rule.

Every visible failure tightens it either way. Only feeling safe over time loosens it, never an argument.

value.title: Why I Keep My Data In Files
value.definition: why my context lives in files an agent can grep rather than in a database
value.settled:
A database assumes you know exactly what you are looking for.

A file system with grep assumes you do not know exactly what you are looking for, which is a much better fit for this case.

I built a fully file-backed database from scratch and did a lift and shift of about three hundred tables out of Postgres into it.

All that context is now just a grep away.

value.title: Why I Overspend On The Marriage
value.definition: why I keep paying above the affordable line for time with Jen
value.settled:
Where my spend on time with Jen runs above the affordable line, the overshoot counterbalances itself a good deal on the marriage lever.

I have no visibility into the rate of that exchange. What I know is that the middle is better than all of one or all of the other.

I learned painfully that not depositing enough into the marriage in the short term brings long term losses that outweigh the savings.

I lose either way right now. This way I lose less overall.

How the relationship is going moves the difficulty of our time inside its band. The better it goes, the more of that time is rated three rather than five. It never goes below three.

Hours logged with Jen for each logged day ran 2.1 in June, 4.0 in July, 2.4 in August and 2.6 so far in September.

My days that reach a peak of four carry more hours with Jen than the days that do not. I spend more time with her because I am doing better rather than the other way round.

value.title: Why I Rebuilt Everything
value.definition: what a better model did to the system I already had
value.settled:
Opus 5 released about a month before the end of August 2026, much better at finding, following and writing instructions.

My three million lines of code and docs were just too much, and everything ground to a halt.

Everything I have built since has been figuring out how to make the environment clean and consistent, with the right context available for the agent at the right time.

All three of those matter. None of them carries it alone.

I have got rid of about a million lines so far.

value.title: Why I Stopped Working
value.definition: the cost of having a job, and what stopping actually bought
value.settled:
At the best-fitting job I could imagine, work still took four fifths of everything I had.

Fitting a role better lowers the multiplier. It does not make having a job cheap.

For a decade each new one fitted better and still cost more, because I was falling faster than I optimised.

The sums had said stop months before. Being fired only set the date.

What retirement really bought was the right to decline. My rule against unaffordable things cannot exist without it.

value.title: Why Macho Costs Me So Much
value.definition: what large, loud and threatening does to me, and why it hit harder than the rest
value.settled:
The anchor is size, threat, loudness, unkindness, and conflict always sitting in the background.

It costs twice over: it breaks what I value and it is expensive to my nervous system at the same time.

Exposure past what I could take encoded as trauma, and the leftover plus the ongoing expense held my baseline negative for years.

These are the ordinary male defaults at full volume, which is why this corner of the space cost the most.

value.title: Why Making Things Hurts
value.definition: an alarm that fires when I make something, and where it came from
value.settled:
The wound is on making, not on playing. A bounded game with rules and a way to win does not fire it.

The alarm is two layers: a floor that is pure structure, and a charge above it that is a belief and can be dissolved.

The alarm concentrates on setting up, before anything begins, and peaks as the setup finishes.

Every criticism of my work lands as a criticism of me.

A judge I can neither escape nor deny installs and grades me from inside forever. One I can walk away from is gone.

value.title: Why My Doing Lags My Believing
value.definition: the only two things that can stand between what I understand and what I do
value.settled:
Understanding a thing fully is already being changed by it, so there is no will in the middle to fail.

Either the understanding still has a hole in it, or the room it calls for is still going up.

Both at once is common, and sometimes the building is how the understanding finishes.

A failure of will would mean knowing exactly how to cause the act, doing that, and the act not happening. That last part disproves one of the first two.

The second kind is time, never character.

value.title: Why People Read As Unsafe
value.definition: the childhood setting that makes people dangerous before any evidence arrives
value.settled:
The deepest thing my body learned as a child is that people are not safe. A setting rather than a conclusion.

My behaviour did not read to my parents, undiagnosed themselves, and correction came as pain. No cruelty in it.

Punishment I could not see coming had nothing to attach to, so it attached to people as a whole.

Under it sits an earlier verdict poured by absence: my needs are not important. The same warm hands.

It was learned, so it can move, but it sits below where argument reaches.

value.title: Why Settling A Question Steadies Me
value.definition: how settling a foundational question takes weight off my nervous system
value.settled:
An open fundamental question never quiets down. It keeps asking at full volume until it is settled.

So settling one takes a standing demand off me, and enough of those lift my safety over time.

The calm is not tidiness. It is the big threats contained: life is a test, it is accounted for, God is there.

Faith reaches me by that door and not the warm one.

Three years at BYU digging at religion, maths, logic and philosophy was the same move: most load comes off at the bottom.

value.title: Why Someone Else's Distress Alarms Me
value.definition: what fires in me when someone near me is hurting, and what it is actually about
value.settled:
Her distress fires mine at once, and it is not her feeling arriving in me.

It is a forecast about my own next minutes: this cue has come before my own pain often enough.

So I go still and regulate rather than move toward her, which is not what she needs.

It carries nothing about her. No why, no cause, no what would help.

Calm months lower what I expect from her and leave the reflex at her cues untouched.

value.title: Why The Going Has To Be The Point
value.definition: why a long piece of work only works if the going itself is worth being in
value.settled:
A long piece of work is lived by a chain of me, and only one is there when it pays off.

So the going has to be worth being in, or nearly every one of them did the work for nothing.

A goal rewritten moves the end into today: not retire, but more freedom tomorrow than I had today.

Most of twenty years of work was drudgery I did believing my needs came last. The rule is the repair.

I cannot reach those selves, so the mourning goes forward into treating the ones I can reach better.

value.title: Why The Peace Holds
value.definition: the quiet rests on trying being unaffordable, not on the need being met
value.settled:
Seeking to be met costs about ten times the loneliness itself, so it is not a real option.

Between commitment and happiness, commitment wins.

value.title: Why Too Much And Too Little Swap Over
value.definition: the same load reading as overwhelming or as empty depending on what I have left
value.settled:
My wiring carries more than most: more connections, less pruned away. That part does not change.

What changes is whether the metering sitting on top of it is working.

Low on resources nothing meters, and the same traffic jams. The jam is the overwhelm.

High on resources it clears so cleanly the day can feel empty at exactly the same load.

The metering runs warm, which is why cold reads as too much and hot reads as too little.

value.title: Working Out How She Thinks
value.definition: I cannot simulate her, so understanding her is a map I build slowly and by hand
value.settled:
Both our anxieties are fair, and not the same: mine is a faculty I lack, hers is a working one on the wrong data.

Predicting her is not closed to me, only expensive. It is a hand-built map doing what a simulator would do free.

She has no written culture and defines her thoughts out loud, mostly with me, so the material only exists once we talk.

Her transition costs are high, so resistance lands on a proposal before its content does.

value.title: Working Out What Love Is
value.definition: building a concept I cannot feel my way into, out of its parts
value.settled:
I have no map for it. The closest I have is commitment, and a lot of data from people built differently.

It is not one thing. Thirteen pieces, some on working hardware, some running quiet, some gated by how safe I am.

Nothing came back missing, and that mixture is itself a candidate for why the word reads as fuzzy.

Support, honesty and openness turn out to be one old alarm at three ranges: her pain near me, caused by me, about me.

value.title: Writing A New Want Into Myself
value.definition: the wants I install in myself, as against the ones that came with me
value.settled:
The given ones fire as desire or as irritation: hunger, loneliness, needless complexity. The rest I wrote in.

Nearly all the written ones serve something else. Improving myself is the one I want for itself.

I cannot install one by deciding to. It has to reach me from where I put it, in what I let myself see.
